zh-tw.podcast_title: 第 35 集：東京安曼 (Aman Tokyo) — 雲端上的隱世神社，直面富士山壯麗絕景
zh-tw.soundscape_title: 雲霄交響曲與黃昏箏鳴 (Symphonie Céleste & Koto au Crépuscule)
zh-tw.soundscape_description: 13弦古箏的高雅琴音，在30米高和紙燈籠巨穹頂的大堂內空靈迴盪，與懸浮於33層緣側（Engawa）石庭的微細水滴聲交織出一曲禪意樂章。
zh-tw.gastronomy_title: Arva 頂級義式饗宴與 Musashi by Aman 頂級 Omakase
zh-tw.gastronomy_dish: 熔岩石燒神戶和牛、佐以十年醞釀醬油的黑鮪魚大腹（Otoro），以及京都宇治抹茶豆乳冰淇淋。
zh-tw.wine_pairing: 前香檳王（Dom Pérignon）首席釀酒師 Richard Geoffroy 打造之 Iwa 5 Assemblage 吟釀，與納帕谷 Kenzo Estate Rindo 頂級紅酒
zh-tw.positive_emotion: 超凡脫俗的靈性凝遠（Sublime Transcendence）— 佇立於雲端之上，俯瞰繁華東京城景與冠雪富士山的巍峨英姿。
zh-tw.client_concern: 對東京飯店空間狹窄的疑慮在踏入客房的瞬間煙消雲散 — 面積介於 71 至 157 平方公尺的奢華套房，堪稱日本首都之最。
zh-tw.target_persona: 追求侘寂（Wabi-Sabi）極簡美學與現代極致奢華的建築美學家、頂尖投資人與品味高雅的世家旅人。
zh-tw.woa_declaration: 此乃亞洲最震撼人心之雲端聖殿 — 值得我們每年蒞臨靜心、遠眺富士山的絕美歸宿！
zh-tw.victor_note: 踏出大手町大樓 33 樓電梯，高達 6 層樓的和紙燈籠穹頂令人屏息。Kerry Hill 的設計無疑是一首光影與空間的永恆詩篇。緊鄰全景落地窗的傳統黑花崗岩日式風呂（Furo），遠眺皇居綠意，帶來無可比擬的超然寧靜。
zh-tw.lucky_note: 秋高氣爽之晨，不妨於清晨 06:15 醒來，遙望西邊地平線上清晰聳立的富士山輪廓。位於 34 樓的 30 米玄武岩池畔是東京最清幽的泳憩聖地；晨泳後，請侍者奉上一杯溫潤的薑香草茶，甚是愜意。
critique_positives: 高達30米的和紙燈籠挑高大堂，被公認為21世紀飯店建築史上的絕世傑作。
全房型皆配備深浴型黑花崗岩日式風呂與傳統障子（Shoji）拉門。
30米高空無邊際泳池直面皇居御苑與富士山絕景。
critique_considerations: Musashi by Aman 壽司吧僅設8席檜木板前座，強烈建議至少提前60天預訂。
面向市區景觀的 Premier 客房未必能遠眺富士山；建議選擇 Suite 或西向 Corner Suite 以確保最佳觀山視野。

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: Victor 哥，站在東京安曼 33 樓的大堂中央，我感覺彷彿整座日本神社與森林都被輕盈地升到了雲端之上！

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: 這正是 Kerry Hill 的大師手筆。他將和紙、黑玄武岩與樟木融合，築起這座高達 30 米的光之燈籠，庇護著賓客內心的平靜。

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: 還有浸泡在花崗岩風呂裡，看著夕陽將富士山頂染成柔粉色的那一刻……那種安寧感真的讓人徹底洗滌心靈。

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: 確實如此。建議各位尊貴讀者透過官方 Expedia 連結預訂，以確保享有富士山景觀房型與 Musashi 的優先訂位特權。

en.podcast_title: Episode 37: Lost in the Fairytale Chateau of La Bastide Amidst Provence's Blooming Lavender Fields
en.soundscape_title: Chant des Cigales & Brise de Lavande
en.soundscape_description: The rhythmic chorus of summer cicadas weaves through ancient olive groves, caught on a gentle breeze carrying the intoxicating scent of lavender across Gordes' cascading cliffside terraces.
en.gastronomy_title: Culinary Elegance: Clover Gordes by Jean-François Piège & The Herb Garden
en.gastronomy_dish: Rosemary-crusted Sisteron lamb chops; Mediterranean sea bass gently steamed with orange-blossom olive oil; and a warm roasted fig tart finished with lavender honey.
en.wine_pairing: Château d’Esclans Garrus Rosé & Domaine de Trévallon Rouge
en.positive_emotion: An intoxicating immersion into Southern French art de vivre—a poetic, slow-paced retreat reminiscent of 18th-century nobility.
en.client_concern: Initial apprehensions regarding the remote countryside setting are effortlessly dispelled by private Rolls-Royce or Mercedes chauffeur transfers from Marseille Airport or Avignon TGV station, complemented by bespoke helicopter charters.
en.target_persona: Discerning families yearning for a fairytale summer escape, refined oenophiles, and couples seeking the ultimate romantic anniversary sanctuary.
en.woa_declaration: THE MOST MAGICAL SANCTUARY IN THE SOUTH OF FRANCE — A SOULFUL HAVEN WE SHALL RETURN TO WITH EVERY SUMMER’S BLOOM!
en.victor_note: Standing upon the ancient stone terrace of La Bastide, the Luberon Valley rolls before you like a hand-woven tapestry of oak green, soft violet lavender, and Roussillon ochre. Staff attired in traditional 18th-century Provençal dress serve chilled rosé with effortless grace and sincere warmth.
en.lucky_note: The majestic Sisley Spa, designed to echo a historic Cistercian abbey with its raw white stone and flickering candlelight, offers an unparalleled sanctuary for rejuvenation. Be sure to reserve a sunset table at L’Orangerie, where the valley transitions mesmerisingly from warm amber to deep violet.
critique_positives: An unrivaled clifftop setting in Gordes, widely heralded as France’s most picturesque village, offering sweeping 360-degree valley panoramas.
Meticulously restored 18th-century chateau architecture, adorned with over 2,000 rare, authentic antique paintings.
A breathtaking outdoor swimming pool framed by slender cypresses and fragrant lavender parterres.
critique_considerations: Seasonal operation (late April through late October); peak lavender blooming season occurs between mid-June and mid-July.
Given the historic layout of the chateau, guest rooms feature unique configurations with ancient stone stairs; request an elevator-accessible suite if mobility preference requires.

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: Victor, standing on this ancient stone balcony looking out over the endless purple carpet of the Luberon, I feel as though we’ve stepped straight into an 18th-century French romantic oil painting!

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: That is the singular magic of La Bastide, my dear. Every carved stone and hand-embroidered Pierre Frey silk curtain was painstakingly curated to recreate an aristocratic Provençal estate in its truest splendor.

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: And dining on the terrace at L’Orangerie—savouring rosemary-roasted lamb with a glass of ice-cold Garrus rosé as the sun sets... absolute perfection.

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: Indubitably. For our discerning readers, I advise booking well before March via our preferred Expedia partner link to secure the finest valley-facing suites.

zh-tw.podcast_title: 第 37 集：迷醉於普羅旺斯薰衣草花海 — 懸崖古堡 La Bastide 的絕美仙境
zh-tw.soundscape_title: 蟬鸣與薰衣草微風 (Chant des Cigales & Brise de Lavande)
zh-tw.soundscape_description: 夏日蟬鳴陣陣，隨微風穿過千年古橄欖樹林，攜帶著濃郁的薰衣草馨香，於高德古村的懸崖梯田花園間悠然瀰漫。
zh-tw.gastronomy_title: 高雅美饌：Jean-François Piège 的 Clover Gordes 與草本花園
zh-tw.gastronomy_dish: 迷迭香炙烤席斯特龍（Sisteron）羊排、橙花橄欖油清蒸地中海海鱸魚，以及佐以薰衣草蜂蜜的烘烤無花果塔。
zh-tw.wine_pairing: 蝶之蘭酒莊 Garrus 頂級粉紅酒與 Trévallon 酒莊紅酒 (Château d’Esclans Garrus Rosé & Domaine de Trévallon Rouge)
zh-tw.positive_emotion: 沉醉於南法生活藝術（Art de Vivre）的頂級芬芳中 — 宛如 18 世紀貴族般，在如畫風光中感受時光靜止的悠然自得。
zh-tw.client_concern: 對於鄉村交通不便的疑慮，在提供馬賽機場或阿維尼翁 TGV 高鐵站的勞斯萊斯/賓士尊榮專車接送，以及私人直升機航線服務下化為烏有。
zh-tw.target_persona: 渴望童話般夏日假期的高淨值家庭、品味非凡的葡萄酒愛好者，以及追求極致浪漫紀念日慶典的頂級奢華情侶。
zh-tw.woa_declaration: 這裏是南法最璀璨奪目的夢幻仙境 — 每當薰衣草盛開之際，便是我們歸來之時！
zh-tw.victor_note: 佇立於 La Bastide 古老的石雕露台上，呂貝隆谷地（Luberon Valley）如同一幅由橡樹綠、薰衣草紫與赭石黃織就的巨幅錦緞在眼前鋪展。身著 18 世紀傳統普羅旺斯服飾的服務人員遞上一杯冰鎮粉紅酒，真摯而溫暖的微笑令人心曠神怡。
zh-tw.lucky_note: 占地廣闊的 Sisley 水療中心汲取古老西斯特修道院建築靈感，以粗磨白石與搖曳燭光打造出完美的療癒聖殿。切記預訂 L'Orangerie 餐廳的夕陽晚餐，親眼目睹谷地從金橙幻化為深紫的絕美時刻。
critique_positives: 屹立於法國最美小鎮高德（Gordes）懸崖峭壁之巔，獨享 360 度無死角俯瞰谷地的震撼全景。
修舊如舊的 18 世紀古堡建築，典藏超過 2,000 幅珍稀古董畫作與藝術品。
絕美戶外泳池聳立於柏樹林與鬱鬱生香的薰衣草花園之間，如夢似幻。
critique_considerations: 飯店採季節性營運（4 月底至 10 月底）；薰衣草最佳觀賞期為 6 月中旬至 7 月中旬。
古堡客房保留原始歷史格局，部分附有石階；如需便利出入，請提前要求附設電梯的房型。

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: Victor，站在這座古老的石雕陽台上，俯瞰整個呂貝隆谷地滿山遍野的薰衣草紫海，我感覺自己彷彿穿越回了上個世紀的法式浪漫夢境中！

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: 這正是 La Bastide 的獨特魅力所在，Lucky。這裡的每一塊古石、每一幅 Pierre Frey 手工刺繡絲綢窗簾，都是經過精挑細選，完美重現了 18 世紀普羅旺斯貴族府邸的璀璨榮光。

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: 還有在 L’Orangerie 露台享用夕陽晚餐，佐以迷迭香烤羊排和一杯冰鎮 Garrus 粉紅酒……世上再沒有比這更完美的時刻了。

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: 確實如此。建議我們尊貴的讀者們在 3 月前透過 Expedia 合作夥伴連結提早預訂，才能鎖定視野最壯麗的呂貝隆谷地景觀套房。

en.podcast_title: Episode 38: Cheval Blanc St-Tropez — Billionaire Whispers Beneath the Umbrella Pines
en.soundscape_title: Murmure Azuréen & Brise des Pins Parasols
en.soundscape_description: The gentle lapping of Mediterranean swells upon the golden sands of Bouillabaisse Beach, intertwining with the breeze whispering through centuries-old umbrella pines.
en.gastronomy_title: La Vague d’Or: The Three-Michelin-Starred Culinary Zenith of Chef Arnaud Donckele
en.gastronomy_dish: Mediterranean sea bass poached in deep sea ocean water with wild aromatic herbs, accompanied by Carqueiranne blue lobster and an ethereal citrus dessert pyramid.
en.wine_pairing: Prestige vintages of Domaine Ott Château de Selle Rosé & Château d’Yquem Sauternes
en.positive_emotion: Sublime emotional transcendence (Couture Luxury)—an unforgettable immersion into LVMH’s pinnacle of French Art de Recevoir.
en.client_concern: Any apprehension regarding the peak-season clamour of Saint-Tropez’s yacht harbour vanishes instantly, thanks to this secluded pine-grove sanctuary featuring a private beach just a ten-minute stroll from the village center.
en.target_persona: The world’s most exacting fine-dining epicures, haute couture collectors, and ultra-high-net-worth individuals seeking absolute privacy and restoration.
en.woa_declaration: THIS IS THE DEFINITIVE COASTAL SANCTUARY OF THE MEDITERRANEAN — WHERE THREE-MICHELIN-STARRED GASTRONOMY BECOMES IMMORTAL POETRY!
en.victor_note: Cheval Blanc St-Tropez stands as the crown jewel of the Côte d’Azur. Masterminded by architect Jean-Michel Wilmotte, its palette of Riviera blue and sandy whites crafts an atmosphere of pure, ethereal marine elegance. Dinner at La Vague d’Or under visionary chef Arnaud Donckele is a sensory voyage so profoundly moving it may well bring tears to your eyes.
en.lucky_note: The private stretch of Bouillabaisse Beach, lined with plush daybeds beneath the dappled shade of ancient pine canopies, is sheer paradise. The moment your feet touch the sand, Cheval Blanc’s intuitive ambassadors present chilled Guerlain facial mists and bespoke suncare.
critique_positives: Home to Saint-Tropez’s sole Three-Michelin-Starred restaurant, helmed by legendary chef Arnaud Donckele
An enviable private white-sand beach commanding unbroken views across the Gulf of Saint-Tropez
The exquisite Cheval Blanc Spa by Guerlain, featuring exclusive olfactory rituals available nowhere else
critique_considerations: An intimate haven of just 30 rooms and suites; near 100% summer occupancy requires booking at least four months in advance
Reservations for La Vague d’Or must be secured concurrently with room confirmation

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor

zh-tw.soundscape_description: 地中海浪濤輕柔撫過 Bouillabaisse 雙色金黃沙灘，與拂過百年石松枝葉的微風交織出一曲天然的寧靜樂章。
zh-tw.gastronomy_title: 主廚 Arnaud Donckele 的三星米其林巔峰之作：La Vague d’Or
zh-tw.gastronomy_dish: 深海海水慢燉地中海海鱸魚佐野生香草，搭配 Carqueiranne 藍龍蝦與高雅精緻的柑橘甜點塔。
zh-tw.wine_pairing: 尊榮選酒：Domaine Ott Château de Selle 桃紅葡萄酒與 Château d’Yquem 貴腐甜白酒

zh-tw.client_concern: 旅人對聖托佩旺季遊艇港口喧囂的顧慮瞬間煙消雲散，全因酒店隱逸於私密石松林間，擁有專屬私人沙灘，且步行至小鎮中心僅需10分鐘。
zh-tw.target_persona: 全球最挑剔的高級法式料理饕客、高訂時裝收藏家，以及渴望尋求極致私密與身心沉澱的頂級富豪。
zh-tw.woa_declaration: 這裏是地中海至高無上的海濱度假殿堂 — 米其林三星美饌在此化作永恆的不朽詩篇！
zh-tw.victor_note: 聖托佩白馬莊園（Cheval Blanc St-Tropez）無疑是蔚藍海岸上最璀璨的明珠。建築大師 Jean-Michel Wilmotte 以蔚藍海藍與沙灘純白為主調，勾勒出如海洋般純粹的空靈空間。在天才主廚 Arnaud Donckele 執掌的 La Vague d’Or 享用晚餐，更是一場令人動容至深、甚至潸然淚下的味蕾藝術之旅。
zh-tw.lucky_note: Bouillabaisse 私人沙灘上，軟墊日照床掩映於百年石松的綠蔭之下，宛如人間天堂。當您踏上細沙的那一刻，白馬莊園的貼身管家便會適時呈上冰鎮 Guerlain 護膚噴霧與頂級防曬用品，奢華微醺至極。
critique_positives: 由傳奇主廚 Arnaud Donckele 親自執掌，榮獲聖托佩唯一米其林三星殊榮的頂級餐廳
細白如雪的私人專屬沙灘，擁抱聖托佩灣（Gulf of Saint-Tropez）無死角壯麗海景
嬌蘭水療中心（Guerlain Spa）提供全台/全球僅白馬莊園獨享的專屬芳香療程

en.podcast_title: Episode 39: Nayara Alto Atacama — A Celestial Sanctuary in the World’s Driest Desert
en.soundscape_title: Silence Cosmique & Souffle du Désert
en.soundscape_description: The absolute stillness of the hyper-arid desert intertwined with the crackle of an open hearth and whispered astronomical lore from a resident astronomer.
en.gastronomy_title: Atacameño Terroir Gastronomy & San Pedro River Valley Produce
en.gastronomy_dish: Tender braised llama infused with fragrant rica-rica pepper, purple corn empanadas, and a delicately sweet chañar fruit ice cream.
en.wine_pairing: Iconic Chilean Vintages: Montes Purple Angel Carménère & Seña from the Colchagua Valley
en.positive_emotion: Cosmic Awe — the arresting revelation of standing beneath an untainted celestial canopy, where the shimmering Milky Way feels vividly within reach.
en.client_concern: Any trepidation regarding Atacama's arid extremities instantly dissolves amidst six refreshing freshwater pools, microclimate humidifying systems, and the Puri Spa featuring volcanic mud rituals.
en.target_persona: High-net-worth explorers, discerning stargazers, and fine-art photographers seeking a profound communion with primitive nature.
en.woa_declaration: THE MOST ASTONISHING SKYSCAPE ON EARTH — WE SHALL RETURN TO BEHOLD THIS UNBLEMISHED COSMIC SPECTACLE!
en.victor_note: Tucked discreetly at the base of the Catarpe Valley’s crimson sandstone peaks, Nayara Alto Atacama melts seamlessly into the desert landscape through traditional adobe architecture. As night falls, the resort’s private observatory, equipped with a professional-grade telescope, unveils Saturn’s rings and glowing nebulae.
en.lucky_note: Soaking in a thermal mineral pool surrounded by red-rock canyon walls after a day exploring the El Tatio geyser field is pure ecstasy. Be sure to indulge in a volcanic hot-stone massage infused with indigenous herbal oils at Puri Spa.
critique_positives: A secluded sanctuary in the Catarpe Valley, entirely untainted by light pollution
Private open-air observatory featuring nightly guided stargazing sessions with resident astronomers
All-inclusive experience enveloping over 30 bespoke desert expeditions and refined fine dining
critique_considerations: Perched at an altitude of 2,400 meters; spend your arrival day resting and sipping coca-leaf tea to acclimatize gracefully
Dramatic desert temperature swings from day (28°C) to night (2°C); tailored thermal outerwear is essential

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: Victor, gazing up at the Atacama night sky, I’ve never seen the Milky Way so luminous and dense. It truly feels as though we are suspended in outer space!

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: Atacama is the stargazing capital of the world, Lucky. The hyper-arid climate and thin, pristine atmosphere transform this basin into Earth’s grandest natural telescope.

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: And gathered around the open fire, sipping a deep Carménère while listening to ancient Atacameño mythology... It’s an unforgettable, magical night.

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: Indeed. Discerning listeners can reserve the All-Inclusive experience via our Expedia partner link to secure private expeditions and exclusive observatory access.

zh-tw.podcast_title: 第39集：Nayara Alto Atacama — 隱於全球最乾燥沙漠中的仰望星河綠洲
zh-tw.soundscape_title: Silence Cosmique & Souffle du Désert (宇宙靜謐與沙漠呼吸)
zh-tw.soundscape_description: 地球上最乾旱沙漠的絕對寂靜，交織著戶外營火的微弱薪鳴，以及天文專家娓娓道來的星座神話與宇宙囁語。
zh-tw.gastronomy_title: 阿塔卡馬風土名饌與聖佩德羅河谷自然饋贈
zh-tw.gastronomy_dish: 慢燉至綿密軟嫩的美洲駝肉佐香草Rica-Rica、紫玉米恩帕納達派餅，以及入口清甜優雅的Chañar野果冰淇淋。
zh-tw.wine_pairing: 智利傳奇紅酒：Montes Purple Angel Carménère 與 智利酒王 Seña（Colchagua Valley）
zh-tw.positive_emotion: 撼動靈魂的宇宙敬畏感（Cosmic Awe）— 當您佇立於浩瀚穹頂之下，數以百萬計的璀璨星辰與清晰可觸的銀河如瀑布般傾瀉而下。
zh-tw.client_concern: 對於阿塔卡馬極端乾旱環境的疑慮，在六座沁涼的水晶淡水池、微氣候加濕系統，以及提供火山礦物泥療法的 Puri Spa 撫慰下消弭無蹤。
zh-tw.target_persona: 追求極致避世的頂級冒險家、熱愛天文星空的雅士，以及渴望與原始大地深度共鳴的攝影大師。
zh-tw.woa_declaration: 「此乃星空奇景之終極聖地 — 我們必將重返，再次仰望那片無瑕璀璨的宇宙銀河！」
zh-tw.victor_note: 隱匿於 Catarpe 山谷壯麗的紅砂岩山腳下，Nayara Alto Atacama 以傳統泥磚（Adobe）建築完美融合於荒漠地貌之中。夜幕低垂之際，度假村專屬的天文台與專業望遠鏡，為賓客揭開土星環與璀璨星雲的浩瀚面紗。
zh-tw.lucky_note: 在經歷一日 El Tatio 噴泉群的探索後，浸泡於紅岩山谷間的天然礦物池中，實為無法言語的至高享受。切勿錯過 Puri Spa 以火山熱石與當地珍稀草本精油進行的全身舒壓療程。
critique_positives: 隱逸於 Catarpe 紅岩山谷深處，完全不受人工光害侵擾
專屬私人天文台，每夜由在地天文學者引領探索銀河奧秘
全包式尊榮禮遇，涵蓋 30 多項客製化沙漠探險與精緻美饌
critique_considerations: 平均海拔達 2,400 公尺；建議抵達首日充分休息並多飲用古柯葉茶以舒緩高山反應
沙漠日夜溫差極大（白天 28°C，夜晚降至 2°C）；請務必準備高階禦寒功能外套

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: Victor 哥，仰望 Atacama 的夜空，我從未見過如此繁密璀璨的銀河，彷彿整個靈魂都飄浮在浩瀚宇宙之中！

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: Atacama 是全球天文觀測的至高聖地。極致乾旱的氣候與稀薄純淨的空氣，讓這裡成為地球上最宏偉的天然望遠鏡。

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: 圍坐在暖火旁，品勻深邃的 Carménère 紅酒，聆聽著 Atacameño 族的古老神話……這絕對是一夜難忘的星空奇蹟。

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: 確實如此。尊貴的聽眾朋友可透過我們獨家合作的 Expedia 連結預訂全包式行程，專享私人探險與天文台觀星特權。

en.podcast_title: Episode 40: Tierra Patagonia — An Elemental Timber Sanctuary at the Edge of the World
en.soundscape_title: Symphonie du Bout du Monde & The Patagonian Gale
en.soundscape_description: The primordial roar of Patagonian gales sweeping across wild steppes, harmonized with the delicate crackle of drifting ice on Lake Sarmiento and the soothing amber embers of the central hearth.
en.gastronomy_title: High-Pampa Gastronomy & Artisanal Spit-Roasted Asado Lamb
en.gastronomy_dish: Crisp-skinned, spit-roasted Cordero Patagónico lamb, succulent Centolla king crab harvested from the Straits of Magellan, crowned with velvety native Calafate berry ice cream.
en.wine_pairing: Clos des Fous Limestone Pinot Noir & Matetic EQ Cold-Climate Syrah
en.positive_emotion: Raw, untamed freedom coupled with profound reverence—the sublime sensation of ultimate cocooned luxury behind soaring glass as snowstorms rage outside.
en.client_concern: Any apprehension of Patagonia's ferocious elements evaporates within Cazú Zegers’ aerodynamic, Lenga-clad masterpiece, where interiors maintain a fragrant, wood-infused 22°C haven.
en.target_persona: Discerning trekkers, design aficionados devoted to sustainable architecture, and luxury wanderers seeking front-row seats to Torres del Paine.
en.woa_declaration: AN ARCHITECTURAL TRIUMPH AT THE END OF THE EARTH — WHERE ICE, ROCK, AND RAW WILDERNESS UNVEIL THEIR MOST MAGNIFICENT SPECTACLE!
en.victor_note: Tierra Patagonia resembles an ancient fossil weathered by desert gales, gently curving along the contours of Lake Sarmiento. Sitting in the central lounge beside the monumental circular hearth, gazing at the iconic granite towers of Torres del Paine through a five-meter glass wall, is unquestionably one of life’s most transcendent moments.
en.lucky_note: The legendary Uma Spa—with its heated indoor infinity pool overlooking Lake Sarmiento and glaciated peaks—offers miraculous restoration after a 20-kilometer trek. Local lore dictates that eating the native Calafate berry guarantees your return to Patagonia; we have no doubt of its spell.
critique_positives: Award-winning eco-architectural masterpiece crafted seamlessly from sustainable native timber
Unobstructed, dramatic panoramas directly facing the legendary granite spires of Torres del Paine
Elite expedition guides curating bespoke journeys across Grey Glacier and the French Valley
critique_considerations: Seasonal sanctuary operating strictly during Austral summer (October to April), closing for the extreme winter
Requires advance booking 6 to 9 months prior due to high international acclaim and exclusive key count

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: Victor, outside this glass wall, 80km/h gales are sweeping across Lake Sarmiento, yet here we are, wrapped in cashmere throws beside a roaring hearth... The contrast is utterly divine.

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: That is the genius of architect Cazú Zegers. She sculpted this lodge as a wooden cocoon of native Lenga, offering an intimate sanctuary amid Patagonia's sublime fury.

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: And after a day trekking to glacial vistas, savoring sweet Centolla king crab with a chilled glass of Pinot Noir... I am certain anyone who tastes this lifestyle is bound to return.

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: Precisely. Our discerning readers may reserve the all-inclusive experience via our trusted Expedia partner link, ensuring seamless expedition logistics and private transfers from Punta Arenas.

zh-tw.podcast_title: 第40集：Tierra Patagonia — 屹立於世界盡頭的溫暖木造聖殿
zh-tw.soundscape_title: 世界盡頭交響曲與巴塔哥尼亞之風 (Symphonie du Bout du Monde & Vent Patagonien)
zh-tw.soundscape_description: 呼嘯於荒涼草原上的巴塔哥尼亞狂風，交織著薩米恩托湖（Lake Sarmiento）浮冰崩解的微弱裂響，與中央壁爐中熠熠生輝的溫暖柴火聲。
zh-tw.gastronomy_title: 巴塔哥尼亞草原極致美饌與傳統木柴烤全羊 (Asado)
zh-tw.gastronomy_dish: 柴火慢烤至外酥內嫩的巴塔哥尼亞羔羊肉（Cordero Patagónico）、引自麥哲倫海峽的鮮甜帝王蟹（Centolla），以及由當地特有卡拉法特果（Calafate）製成的絲滑冰淇淋甜點。
zh-tw.wine_pairing: Clos des Fous 石灰岩黑皮諾紅酒與 Matetic EQ 冷涼微氣候西拉紅酒
zh-tw.positive_emotion: 原始純粹的自由感與對自然的崇高敬畏——當窗外雪暴狂怒之際，蜷縮於木質溫馨繭房中的無上安逸。
zh-tw.client_concern: 智利建築大師 Cazú Zegers 以流線型空氣動力學打造原生 Lenga 木結構，將室內維持於 22°C 並彌漫著淡淡木香，令所有對嚴酷氣候的擔憂蕩然無存。
zh-tw.target_persona: 熱愛徒步探險的奢華旅人、永續建築美學的崇拜者，以及渴望親睹百內國家公園（Torres del Paine）奇景的品味名流。
zh-tw.woa_declaration: 屹立於世界盡頭的頂級建築傑作——在此，您將親眼見證冰川與山巒交織出的絕世壯麗！
zh-tw.victor_note: Tierra Patagonia 宛如被風沙雕琢的古老化石，順應著薩米恩托湖畔的起伏地形蜿蜒而建。坐在中央大廳的巨型環形壁爐旁，透過高達 5 米的全景玻璃牆凝望百內花園（Torres del Paine）雄偉的花崗岩巨塔，堪稱人生中最震撼心靈的絕景之一。
zh-tw.lucky_note: 設有室內溫水無邊際泳池的 Uma Spa 直面薩米恩托湖與冰川群山，是徒步 20 公里後舒緩身心的奇蹟聖地。當地傳說，凡品嚐過卡拉法特果（Calafate）的人終將重返巴塔哥尼亞，而我們深信這道魔咒定會應驗。
critique_positives: 榮獲多項國際權威大獎的永續原生木造建築傑作
坐擁直面百內塔（Torres del Paine）傳奇花崗岩尖峰的無遮蔽絕美景致
配備頂級專業導覽團隊，提供葛雷冰川（Grey Glacier）與法國谷（French Valley）的專屬探險行程
critique_considerations: 採季節性營運（僅於南半球夏季的 10 月至次年 4 月開放），嚴冬期間暫停營業
因客房數量稀缺且受全球名流追捧，建議提前 6 至 9 個月預訂

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: Victor，玻璃窗外是每小時 80 公里的狂風掃過薩米恩托湖，而我們卻裹著羊絨毯蜷縮在溫暖的火爐旁……這種對比簡直奇妙至極！

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: 這正是建築師 Cazú Zegers 的絕妙之處。她將這座酒店打造為由原生 Lenga 木材築成的溫柔風繭，在巴塔哥尼亞狂野的自然力量面前，給予旅人最貼心的庇護。

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: 在經歷一整天探險冰川的徒步行程後，品嚐鮮甜的帝王蟹並抿一口微醺的黑皮諾紅酒……我相信任何曾在此駐足的人，都會渴望再次重返。

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: 一點也不錯。我們尊貴的讀者可透過合作夥伴 Expedia 連結預訂全包式奢華套裝行程，確保享有完善的探險日程安排與 Punta Arenas 機場的專屬接送服務。

en.podcast_title: Episode 42: Royal Mansour Marrakech — Unveiling the Moroccan Sovereign’s Secret Palace
en.soundscape_title: Murmure des Fontaines & Oiseaux de l’Oliveraie
en.soundscape_description: The gentle murmur of zellige-tiled fountains blending harmoniously with bird chirps in orange-laden groves, punctuated by the resonant reverberations of the iconic Koutoubia call.
en.gastronomy_title: Royal Moroccan Gastronomy & Three-Michelin-Starred Chef Hélène Darroze
en.gastronomy_dish: Heritage lamb tagine with wild honey and roasted walnuts, followed by a crisp pigeon pastilla delicately dusted with cinnamon-infused powdered sugar, artfully refined by Hélène Darroze.
en.wine_pairing: Steaming pot of royal mint tea brewed from freshly plucked mint & Domaine Val d'Argan red wine from the foothills of the Atlas.
en.positive_emotion: An ethereal sense of Arabian Nights regal majesty (Imperial Splendor)—absolute reverence and unmatched discretion within a palatial retreat comprising exclusively private multi-story riads.
en.client_concern: Any trace of privacy concern is effortlessly dissipated via a masterfully engineered subterranean tunnel system, allowing staff and personal butlers to navigate invisibly without disrupting guests.
en.target_persona: Monarchs, heads of state, and global high-net-worth discerning travelers seeking the pinnacle of absolute privacy and world-class artisanal craftsmanship.
en.woa_declaration: THE MOST OPULENT PALATIAL HOTEL ON EARTH — A LIVING MASTERPIECE OF ONE THOUSAND AND ONE NIGHTS!
en.victor_note: Commissioned directly by King Mohammed VI and meticulously crafted by 1,200 of Morocco’s premier artisans over five years, Royal Mansour is not merely a hotel—it is a sovereign citadel. From intricately hand-chiseled zellige tiles to hand-carved cedarwood doors and lace-like silk drapery, it exudes a regal grandeur no resort could ever replicate.
en.lucky_note: At Royal Mansour, one does not merely check into a room; one inherits a private three-story Riad featuring an intimate inner courtyard, cozy fireplace, and a private plunge pool beneath the starlit sky. The iconic Royal Mansour Spa, framed in cloud-white lattice lace, offers Africa’s most exquisite traditional Hammam ritual.
critique_positives: Every guest resides in an independent, three-story private Riad complete with 24/7 dedicated butler service.
A subterranean tunnel network ensures absolute, uncompromised privacy throughout your stay.
The delicate white lace-encased Royal Mansour Spa is widely acclaimed as the most breathtaking spa sanctuary on earth.
critique_considerations: As the three-story Riad architecture features stairs along with a private elevator, guests traveling with elderly companions should request a tailored layout.
The coveted Royal Hammam ritual requires reservations at least 48 hours in advance due to exceptionally high demand.

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: Victor, stepping through the majestic bronze gates of Royal Mansour felt like walking directly into the pages of One Thousand and One Nights. Every single zellige tile and cedarwood motif is meticulously hand-carved!

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: Indeed, Lucky. This is a sovereign palace built by the King himself. The true magic lies in its invisible service—you will never encounter a luggage trolley or housekeeper in the main corridors, as they move quietly through a secret subterranean network.

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: And that three-story Riad with a private rooftop plunge pool overlooking the Koutoubia mosque... Sipping fresh mint tea while watching the deep red sunset drape over Marrakech is simply priceless.

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: Precisely. Dear listeners, book early via our Expedia partner link to secure priority Riad upgrades and complimentary VIP airport reception in Marrakech.

zh-tw.podcast_title: 第 42 集：馬拉喀什皇家曼蘇爾酒店 — 揭開摩洛哥國王隱密宮殿的神秘面紗
zh-tw.soundscape_title: Murmure des Fontaines & Oiseaux de l’Oliveraie（噴泉低語與橄欖園鳥鳴）
zh-tw.soundscape_description: Zellige 瓷磚噴泉潺潺流水聲，與結滿果實的橙園鳥鳴完美交織，伴隨著古老庫圖比亞清真寺遠道而來的悠揚鐘音。
zh-tw.gastronomy_title: 摩洛哥皇室御宴與米其林三星名廚 Hélène Darroze 的匠心演繹
zh-tw.gastronomy_dish: 傳統蜜汁核桃燉羊肉 Tagine，以及由 Hélène Darroze 精心演繹、外皮酥脆並灑上香桂糖粉的法式鴿肉派 Pastilla。
zh-tw.wine_pairing: 皇室銀壺現沖鮮薄荷茶，搭配來自阿特拉斯山麓的 Domaine Val d’Argan 頂級紅葡萄酒。
zh-tw.positive_emotion: 宛如置身《一千零一夜》的帝王尊榮感（Imperial Splendor）——在毫無普通客房、全數為獨立私人府邸的浩瀚宮殿中，感受極致恭敬與無可比擬的隱密性。
zh-tw.client_concern: 對隱私的任何疑慮在此徹底化為烏有——巧妙的地下密道系統讓私人管家與服務人員如隱形般穿梭，絲毫不打擾賓客的尊貴時光。
zh-tw.target_persona: 全球皇室成員、國家元首，以及對極致隱私與頂級手工藝有著不妥協追求的頂級富豪賓客。
zh-tw.woa_declaration: 此乃全球最頂級奢華的皇室宮殿酒店 — 活生生再現的《一千零一夜》傳奇傑作！
zh-tw.victor_note: 由摩洛哥國王穆罕默德六世親自委託 1,200 位頂尖國寶級匠人耗時五年雕琢，Royal Mansour 絕非僅是一間酒店，而是一座縮小版的皇城。從每一塊手工 Zellige 瓷磚、雪松木雕門扇到絲綢蕾絲窗幔，無不散發著絕無僅有、無法複製尊貴氣度。
zh-tw.lucky_note: 在 Royal Mansour，您租下的絕非普通房型，而是一整座三層樓的私人 Riad 府邸，配備天井中庭、溫馨壁爐與露台觀星泳池。宛如純白蕾絲鳥籠般空靈的 Royal Mansour Spa，更是體驗全非洲最頂級傳統水療 Hammam 的夢幻聖地。
critique_positives: 每位賓客獨享一座獨立三層樓 Riad 私人府邸，並配備 24 小時全天候專屬管家服務。
精密設計的地下地道網路，為賓客營造無可比擬的絕對尊榮隱私。
由精細純白蕾絲雕琢而成的 Royal Mansour Spa，被譽為地球上最震撼人心的水療殿堂。
critique_considerations: 鑑於三層樓 Riad 建築包含樓梯及私人電梯，若與長者同行，建議提前要求安排最適宜的空間佈局。
因預訂極為踴躍，尊貴的皇室 Hammam 傳統水療體驗需至少提前 48 小時預訂。

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: Victor 哥，當我踏進 Royal Mansour 那座宏偉的青銅巨門時，真的以為自己穿越到了《一千零一夜》的世界。每一塊瓷磚、每一處雪松木雕都是匠人純手工雕琢的！

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: 一點也沒錯，Lucky。這是國王親自打造的皇宮。最令人驚歎的是，你在主通道上絕不會看到任何行李車或清潔人員，因為他們全都透過極其隱密的地道系統無聲移動。

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: 還有那座帶有頂樓私人泳池、能遠眺庫圖比亞塔的三層樓 Riad……一邊啜飲鮮薄荷茶，一邊凝望馬拉喀什那抹火紅的日落，這種體驗簡直無價。

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: 正是如此。各位聽眾，歡迎儘早透過我們的 Expedia 合作夥伴連結預訂，即可享有優先升等 Riad 及馬拉喀什機場 VIP 迎賓禮遇。

en.soundscape_title: Symphonie du Canal & Twilight Lounge
en.soundscape_description: The gentle lapping of waters against a private yacht in Marasi Bay, harmoniously interwoven with refined piano melodies at The Gallery and the warm desert breeze at sunset.
en.gastronomy_title: Haute Pâtisserie by World Champion Angelo Musa & Basque Gastronomy by Martín Berasategui
en.gastronomy_dish: The iconic 100% Vanilla Cake by World Champion Angelo Musa alongside exquisite basil-infused cod tapas at Jara by Martín Berasategui.
en.wine_pairing: Champagne Ruinart Blanc de Blancs & An Exclusive Collection of Royal Arabian Date Mocktails
en.positive_emotion: Sculptural Splendor — Uncompromised poise, quiet sophistication, and the awe of admiring a monumental architectural masterpiece in the heart of modern Dubai.
en.client_concern: Any apprehensions regarding Dubai’s urban intensity are effortlessly dissolved by the tranquil sanctuary of Marasi Bay, situated merely five minutes from the Burj Khalifa via private Rolls-Royce chauffeur.
en.target_persona: Architectural connoisseurs, industry titans, and discerning tastemakers seeking the apex of contemporary British-inspired luxury.
en.woa_declaration: THE ULTIMATE MANIFESTO OF CONTEMPORARY LUXURY IN DUBAI — WHERE FOSTER + PARTNERS’ ARCHITECTURAL ARTISTRY REACHES ABSOLUTE PERFECTION!
en.victor_note: The Lana stands as the inaugural masterpiece for the Dorchester Collection in the Middle East. Featuring Foster + Partners' interconnected cantilevered architecture and interiors penned by Gilles & Boissier, the tower reveals breathtaking vistas overlooking the iconic Burj Khalifa skyline. Indulging in afternoon tea curated by World Champion Pastry Chef Angelo Musa is an epicurean privilege like no other.
en.lucky_note: The 30th-floor rooftop infinity pool offers Dubai's most sublime sunset vantage point. Choose the Marina Suite, where a freestanding marble bathtub rests beside floor-to-ceiling glass overlooking luxury yachts along Marasi Bay. Booking through our Expedia partner channel unlocks VIP airport transfers and a $100 resort culinary credit.
critique_positives: Norman Foster's groundbreaking cantilevered architectural design featuring soaring double-height ceilings and expansive private terraces
An elite culinary duo featuring 12-Michelin-starred Chef Martín Berasategui and World Pastry Champion Angelo Musa
A dramatic 30th-floor rooftop infinity pool offering unobstructed, front-row panoramas of the iconic Burj Khalifa
critique_considerations: Portions of Marasi Bay's adjacent marina are finalizing construction; request upper suites on floor 18 and above for completely unobstructed vistas
The rooftop infinity pool is exclusively reserved for hotel guests during the day; non-resident guests should reserve tables well in advance for High Society lounge in the evening

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: Victor, stepping into the lobby of The Lana, I immediately felt London's high-society poise harmonizing beautifully with the radiance of Marasi Bay. The architecture is utterly mesmerizing!

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: And soaking in that marble bath as the Burj Khalifa illuminates at dusk... it truly is a breathless 'WOA' moment.

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor

zh-tw.soundscape_title: 運河交響曲與暮光沙龍 (Symphonie du Canal & Lounge Crépusculaire)
zh-tw.soundscape_description: 私人遊艇於瑪拉西灣（Marasi Bay）水面輕拂的波浪聲，交織著 The Gallery 精緻優雅的鋼琴琴音，與黃昏時分吹來的溫暖沙漠微風。
zh-tw.gastronomy_title: 世界甜點冠軍 Angelo Musa 與 12 星米其林大師 Martín Berasategui 的頂尖饗宴
zh-tw.gastronomy_dish: 傳奇甜點大師 Angelo Musa 名震遐邇的 100% 梵尼蘭（香草）蛋糕，以及 Jara by Martín Berasategui 餐廳呈獻的極品羅勒鱈魚 Tapas。
zh-tw.wine_pairing: Ruinart Blanc de Blancs 銘悅香檳與阿拉伯皇室椰棗特調無酒精調酒
zh-tw.positive_emotion: 極致高雅與恢弘雕塑之美（Sculptural Splendor）——置身現代杜拜心臟地帶，仰望宛如當代藝術雕塑般偉大建築的震撼與驕傲。
zh-tw.client_concern: 旅人對杜拜繁喧的顧慮在此被完美化解——瑪拉西灣的幽靜水岸帶來絕佳寧靜，而搭乘專屬 Rolls-Royce 尊榮禮車前往哈里發塔僅需 5 分鐘。
zh-tw.target_persona: 追求現代英倫奢華標竿的建築設計師、商界精英與品味卓絕的層峰伴侶。
zh-tw.woa_declaration: 此乃杜拜現代奢華之巔峰——Foster + Partners 建築藝術達到完美無瑕的致敬之作！
zh-tw.victor_note: The Lana 為多切斯特精選酒店集團（Dorchester Collection）於中東開設的首間奢華地標。由 Foster + Partners 操刀的多層交錯雕塑塔樓，搭配 Gilles & Boissier 設計的優雅室內空間，交織出遠眺哈里發塔天際線的壯麗視野。在此細品世界甜點冠軍 Angelo Musa 主理的英式下午茶，堪稱一場真正的味蕾特權。
zh-tw.lucky_note: 位於 30 樓的頂樓無邊際泳池，是沉醉於杜拜金黃夕陽的最佳奢華角。特別推薦入住「水岸套房」（Marina Suite），於落地玻璃窗旁的獨立大理石浴缸中泡澡，向下俯瞰瑪拉西灣徐徐航行的私人遊艇。經由 Expedia 合作夥伴渠道預訂，即可尊享 VIP 機場接送與 100 美元餐飲抵用金。
critique_positives: 諾曼·福斯特（Norman Foster）開創性的雕塑感建築結構，擁有高挑大器的大廳與開闊的私人陽台
由 12 星米其林名廚 Martín Berasategui 與世界甜點冠軍 Angelo Musa 聯手打造的高級餐飲陣容
30 樓頂樓無邊際泳池，將哈里發塔（Burj Khalifa）的璀璨全景盡收眼底
critique_considerations: 瑪拉西灣部分鄰近碼頭區域仍在進行工程；建議預訂 18 樓以上的的高樓層房型以獲致最開闊的景觀
頂樓無邊際泳池於白天僅供住客專享；非住客如欲於晚間前往 High Society 酒吧，請務必提前預訂桌位

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: Victor，當我踏入 The Lana 的大堂，瞬間感受到了倫敦頂級貴族的優雅底蘊與瑪拉西灣水岸光影的完美融合。這裡的建築線條真的令人嘆為觀止！

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: 這是因為 Foster + Partners 耗費多年精力精確計算每一道光線的雕刻切面。而 Angelo Musa 的香草甜點……在杜拜絕無僅有。

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: 還有在傍晚浸泡在大理石浴缸裡，著眼於哈里發塔點燈的那一刻……真的會讓人由衷發出『WOA』的讚嘆！

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: 一點也沒錯。記得提醒各位讀者透過 Expedia 官方合作夥伴連結預訂，即可獲贈尊榮美味早餐與優先升等高樓層房型。

shorts.visual: Angelo Musa 輕輕切開酥脆的外皮，露出質地絲滑的馬達加斯加香草內餡。

en.podcast_title: Episode 43: Splendido Portofino — The Legendary Haven of Elizabeth Taylor’s Eternal Romance
en.soundscape_title: Chant des Cigales & Vagues de Ligurie
en.soundscape_description: A rhythmic crescendo of summer cicadas echoing through olive groves and cascading magenta bougainvillea, blending seamlessly with the distant chimes of San Giorgio Church and the gentle purr of luxury yachts gliding across Portofino Bay.
en.gastronomy_title: Ligurian Seafood Gastronomy & The Legendary La Terrazza
en.gastronomy_dish: Handcrafted Trofie pasta tossed in authentic Genoese basil pesto, crushed by hand in a marble mortar by Executive Chef Corrado Corti, accompanied by sweet Santa Margherita prawns and warm, crisp focaccia.
en.wine_pairing: Mineral-driven Cinque Terre DOC white wine paired with a sweet, nectarous fresh peach Bellini.
en.positive_emotion: The quintessential cinematic romance of La Dolce Vita—an intoxicating immersion into the timeless glamour of 1960s Italian cinema.
en.client_concern: Any lingering hesitation regarding Portofino's bustling summer harbour dissolves completely upon arriving at this serene hilltop sanctuary, featuring a shaded, cobblestone pathway leading directly down to the marina.
en.target_persona: Silver-screen icons, connoisseurs of classical Italian arts, and discerning couples seeking the Mediterranean's most enchanting honeymoon destination.
en.woa_declaration: THIS IS THE ABSOLUTE PINNACLE OF ITALIAN LA DOLCE VITA — WE SHALL RETURN EVERY SINGLE SUMMER!
en.victor_note: Once a 16th-century Benedictine monastery, Splendido commands an unrivaled, sweeping panorama of Portofino's crescent bay. Verandah dining at La Terrazza, watching superyachts shimmer in the golden twilight over a plate of fragrant pestled trofie, is the exact moment you understand why Elizabeth Taylor and Richard Burton chose this hideaway as their romantic haven.
en.lucky_note: Perched dramatically along bougainvillea-clad cliffs, the heated outdoor saltwater pool remains the estate's most prized sanctuary. The hotel maintains a classic mahogany sailboat for private, bespoke picnics along the coast of San Fruttuoso. Reserve your ocean-facing suite via our Expedia affiliate partner to secure priority access to the finest sunset dining tables.
critique_positives: An exclusive hilltop vantage point offering sweeping, unobstructed vistas over Portofino Bay and the Ligurian Sea
Rich 16th-century monastic heritage enveloped by terraced gardens of ancient olive trees and vibrant bougainvillea
Bespoke transfers via private mahogany vessel and golf buggies for effortless access to the harbour
critique_considerations: Operates seasonally from April through October; peak summer months (June–August) require booking at least five months in advance
Non-balcony rooms feature cozy proportions true to historic monastic architecture; an upgrade to a Junior Suite Sea View is highly recommended

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: Victor, sitting on the balcony at Splendido looking out over Portofino Bay framed by those iconic pastel houses... I feel as though I’ve stepped right into a classic Italian romance film!

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: That is the sheer magic of Belmond, my dear. They have preserved the soul of this 16th-century monastery while elevating service to absolute perfection. Their Trofie al Pesto is the gold standard across all of Liguria.

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: And that sunset cruise on their private wooden sailboat toward San Fruttuoso... it is the ultimate expression of romance!

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: Precisely. Do remind our readers to book via our Expedia partner link to enjoy complimentary Italian breakfast and priority privileges for private yacht experiences.

shorts.title: Short 1: Where Hollywood Legends Fell in Love
shorts.hook: What makes this hilltop hideaway—where Elizabeth Taylor and Richard Burton got engaged—so utterly enchanting?
shorts.visual: A picturesque frame of bougainvillea-draped terraces overlooking the azure waters of Portofino Bay.
shorts.cta: Read the complete Splendido guide at travel4u.us

shorts.title: Short 2: The World's Best Pesto Pasta View
shorts.hook: Italy's finest pesto trofie, served with the most breathtaking panorama high above Portofino!
shorts.visual: Executive Chef tossing vibrant green basil pesto trofie against the backdrop of the endless Mediterranean horizon.
shorts.cta: Explore Splendido's culinary art at travel4u.us

shorts.hook: A heated saltwater pool carved into the cliffside, overlooking Portofino's shimmering superyachts!
shorts.visual: Crystal-clear pool waters merging seamlessly into the Mediterranean horizon.

zh-tw.podcast_title: 第43集：Splendido Portofino —— 伊莉莎白泰勒與理查波頓的傳奇摯愛聖地
zh-tw.soundscape_title: 蟬鳴與利古里亞海浪（Chant des Cigales & Vagues de Ligurie）
zh-tw.soundscape_description: 夏蟬於橄欖樹林與盛放紫藤花瀑間交織迴響，與聖喬治教堂的悠揚鐘聲及波托菲諾灣中奢華遊艇的微弱引擎聲交織成絕美樂章。
zh-tw.gastronomy_title: 利古里亞海鮮珍饈與傳奇 La Terrazza 景觀餐廳
zh-tw.gastronomy_dish: 由行政主廚 Corrado Corti 親自以石臼手舂的热那亚羅勒青醬手工 Trofie 麵，佐以聖瑪格麗特灣特產鮮甜龍蝦與香脆熱壓佛卡夏麵包。
zh-tw.wine_pairing: 帶有礦物韻味的 Cinque Terre DOC 白葡萄酒，搭佐蜜桃甜香的現壓 Bellini 雞尾酒。
zh-tw.positive_emotion: 經典「甜蜜生活」（La Dolce Vita）的電影般浪漫 —— 深陷於 60 年代義大利影壇極致旖旎與不朽情愫之中。
zh-tw.client_concern: 波托菲諾港口夏季的喧囂擁擠，在登臨這處隱逸山頂避世所的瞬間煙消雲散；綠樹成蔭的石板小徑直通碼頭，靜謐與繁華僅一步之遙。
zh-tw.target_persona: 好萊塢巨星、義大利古典藝術鑑賞家，以及尋覓地中海頂級浪漫蜜月之旅的品味伴侶。
zh-tw.woa_declaration: 此乃義式「甜蜜生活」（LA DOLCE VITA）之頂級殿堂 —— 每個夏天，我們都將重返此處！
zh-tw.victor_note: 這座由 16 世紀本篤會修道院蛻變而來的 Splendido，俯瞰著波托菲諾如月牙般的優雅海灣。置身 La Terrazza 餐廳露台，品嚐香氣繚繞的羅勒青醬麵，凝望夕陽餘暉下波光粼粼的超級遊艇，那一刻您便會明白，為何伊莉莎白泰勒與理查波頓會選擇在此構築他們的愛情誓約。
zh-tw.lucky_note: 懸掛於九重葛崖壁旁的室外溫水海水泳池，是全酒店最為奢華尊貴的放鬆之所。酒店更備有傳奇木造桃花心木帆船，專為賓客提供前往聖弗魯托索海岸的私密野餐航程。建議透過合作夥伴 Expedia 預訂海景客房，優先鎖定夕陽時分最佳景觀席位。
critique_positives: 雄踞山崖絕佳地理位置，一覽無餘盡收波托菲諾灣與利古里亞海壯麗全景
深厚 16 世紀修道院歷史底蘊，梯田花園中古橄欖樹與艷麗九重葛交相輝映
尊享私人木造船隻專屬接駁，及球車穿梭服務直達港口碼頭
critique_considerations: 酒店採季節性營運（每年 4 月至 10 月）；夏季旺季（6 至 8 月）建議至少提前 5 個月預訂
無陽台房型保留古修道院建築結構，空間相對精巧，極力推薦升等至海景小套房（Junior Suite Sea View）

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: Victor，坐在 Splendido 的陽台上俯瞰波托菲諾灣，看著那些繽紛柔和色彩的房屋……我感覺自己彷彿置身於經典義大利浪漫電影的劇照之中！

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: 這正是 Belmond 的絕妙魔力。他們完美保留了 16 世紀古修道院的靈魂，同時注入無可挑剔的頂級服務。這裡的羅勒青醬手工 Trofie 麵更是整個利古里亞地區的黃金標準。

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: 還有搭乘專屬木造帆船，在黃昏時刻出海巡航至聖弗魯托索修道院……那簡直是浪漫的極致體驗！

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: 一點也沒錯。請務必提醒讀者透過我們的 Expedia 合作夥伴連結預訂，即可尊享免費義式早餐及專屬私人遊艇體驗特權。

en.podcast_title: Episode 44: The Brando, Tetiaroa — The Private Sanctuary of Marlon Brando and World Leaders
en.soundscape_title: Souffle du Lagon & Chant Polynésien
en.soundscape_description: The distant, rhythmic swell breaking over outer barrier reefs, intertwined with gentle rustles through tropical coconut fronds and the soulful acoustic strains of Tahitian ukuleles.
en.gastronomy_title: Franco-Polynesian Haute Gastronomy with Executive Chef Jean-Sébastien Gidouin
en.gastronomy_dish: Freshly caught Poisson Cru steeped in freshly pressed coconut milk, lagoon lobster grilled in banana leaves, and exquisite Tahitian vanilla bean gelato.
en.wine_pairing: Champagne Billecart-Salmon Brut Rosé & Vin de Tahiti Coral-Grown White Wine
en.positive_emotion: Pure Eden—an intoxicating surrender of modern civilization to reside within an unblemished island sanctuary entirely untouched by the outside world.
en.client_concern: Any apprehension of isolation or environmental impact dissipates completely: The Brando achieves 100% energy independence via solar arrays, coconut biofuel, and a revolutionary 900-meter deep-sea water air conditioning system (SWAC).
en.target_persona: Tech titans, eco-preservationists, former heads of state (where President Obama penned his memoirs), and discerning couples seeking absolute, unchallenged seclusion.
en.woa_declaration: THE MOST MAGNIFICENT ECO-LUXURY ISLAND RESORT ON EARTH — PROOF THAT PARADISE TRULY EXISTS.
en.victor_note: Tetiaroa once served as the exclusive royal retreat for Tahitian kings before being acquired by Hollywood legend Marlon Brando as his private sanctuary. Accessible solely via a 20-minute private flight from Tahiti, 35 beachfront villas are seamlessly veiled beneath lush palm canopy, unfolding directly onto a mirror-still, crystal-turquoise lagoon.
en.lucky_note: Each villa boasts a private plunge pool and a sandy path opening onto a pristine coral strand. Do not miss the guided kayak expedition to Bird Island alongside marine biologists from the Tetiaroa Society Research Station. When reserved through our partner link on Expedia, gourmet dining and daily holistic spa treatments are fully inclusive.
critique_positives: The world’s premier zero-carbon luxury resort, pioneering 900-meter deep-sea water air conditioning
Unrivaled seclusion: every villa commands its own pristine beach strip, completely shielded from neighboring gaze
The ethereal Varua Te Ora Polynesian Spa, suspended over a tranquil freshwater lagoon like a heavenly sanctuary
critique_considerations: An exclusive offering of just 35 villas across the entire atoll; bookings 6 to 9 months in advance are imperative for holiday seasons
Arrival is strictly via the resort's private Air Tetiaroa charter flight from Papeete Airport (Tahiti)

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: Victor, stepping off the private plane onto Tetiaroa's airstrip, the crystalline turquoise hues of the lagoon are so utterly breathtaking that your eyes can scarcely believe it is real!

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: Precisely why Marlon Brando acquired this entire atoll while filming Mutiny on the Bounty, my dear. He was determined to preserve its pristine purity forever. Zero litter, zero carbon emissions, powered entirely by the sun.

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: And swimming alongside gentle sea turtles right off your villa's private deck... Words truly fail to capture the profound serenity at The Brando!

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: Indeed. I recommend our readers reserve the All-Inclusive package via our partner link on Expedia to enjoy curated eco-expeditions and round-trip private air transfers seamlessly included.

zh-tw.podcast_title: 第44集：特提亞羅亞白蘭度渡假村（The Brando）— 瑪龍白蘭度與元首的私密世外桃源
zh-tw.soundscape_title: Souffle du Lagon & Chant Polynésien (潟湖微風與玻里尼西亞頌歌)
zh-tw.soundscape_description: 遠方外海珊瑚礁浪濤的溫柔迴響，交織著熱帶椰林間颯颯微風，以及大溪地工藝名家吟唱拂弄的悠揚烏克麗麗琴聲。
zh-tw.gastronomy_title: 法式玻里尼西亞奢華珍饌與行政主廚 Jean-Sébastien Gidouin
zh-tw.gastronomy_dish: 鮮榨椰漿冷萃的傳統 Poisson Cru 鮮椰汁醃生鮪魚、香蕉葉包裹慢烤的潟湖龍蝦，以及頂級大溪地香草冰淇淋。
zh-tw.wine_pairing: Billecart-Salmon Brut Rosé 玫瑰香檳與種植於珊瑚礁岩的 Vin de Tahiti 珍稀白葡萄酒
zh-tw.positive_emotion: 純粹原生態 Eden 仙境—徹底卸下現代文明喧囂，全身心沉浸於杳無人跡的私人島嶼天堂。
zh-tw.client_concern: 對遙遠偏僻與碳足跡的疑慮隨之煙消雲散：The Brando 透過太陽能、椰子生物柴油以及 900 公尺深層海水空調系統（SWAC），實現 100% 能源自給自足的永續奢華。
zh-tw.target_persona: 科技億萬富豪、環境保育家、國家元首（歐巴馬總統撰寫回憶錄之處），以及尋求絕對私密與隱世匿痕的極致伴侶。
zh-tw.woa_declaration: 這裡 elected 地球上最壯麗絕美的頂級永續渡假島嶼 — 人間仙境的終極具象！
zh-tw.victor_note: 特提亞羅亞（Tetiaroa）曾是大溪地古代皇室專屬的夏日避暑皇居，後成為好萊塢傳奇巨星瑪龍·白蘭度的私人島嶼。從大溪地搭乘專屬私人飛機僅需20分鐘即可抵達，35座濱海別墅完美隱匿於鬱鬱蔥蔥的椰林之中，直通如玻璃般澄澈透明的蔚藍潟湖。
zh-tw.lucky_note: 每座別墅皆設有私人無邊際泳池與一條蜿蜒於沙灘的小徑，直達極致寧靜的珊瑚海岸。切勿錯過與 Tetiaroa 科學研究站生物學家一同划 Kayak 探訪「飛鳥島（Bird Island）」的獨家生態之旅。經由合作夥伴 Expedia 預訂，所有頂級美饌與每日 Spa 水療療程皆已完美包含於全包式尊榮禮遇中。
critique_positives: 全球首座極致零碳排頂級渡假村，配備開創性的 900 公尺深層海水空調降溫技術
無與倫比的私密性：每座別墅獨享一片白沙海岸，視野完全阻隔、不受鄰舍干擾
宛如人間仙境的 Varua Te Ora 玻里尼西亞水療中心，靜靜矗立於淡水潟湖之上
critique_considerations: 全島僅限量 35 座奢華別墅；節假日奢華假期強烈建議提前 6 至 9 個月預訂
必須搭乘渡假村專屬 Air Tetiaroa 私人飛機從帕皮提（Papeete）機場前往

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: Victor，當我從私人飛機踏上特提亞羅亞跑道的那刻，那片蔚藍潟湖的漸層寶石色彩簡直如夢似幻，親眼所見都難以置信！

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: 這正是瑪龍·白蘭度在拍攝《叛艦喋血記》時決定買下整座島嶼的原因。他渴望為後世永恆守護這片純淨無瑕。這裡沒有一絲雜物、零碳排放，全島皆由太陽能溫柔滋養。

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: 還能在別墅階梯前與溫順的海龜一同悠游… The Brando 所散發的安寧與祥和，文字真的無法形容其萬一！

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: 確實如此。建議讀者透過合作夥伴 Expedia 預訂尊榮全包式禮遇，即可享有一切生態探險行程與雙程專屬私人飛機接送。

shorts.title: Short 1: Marlon Brando's Secret Private Atoll
shorts.hook: 好萊塢傳奇瑪龍·白蘭度的私人島嶼，亦是歐巴馬總統撰寫回憶錄的隱世秘境！
shorts.visual: 航拍鏡頭由高空俯瞰特提亞羅亞環形寶石藍潟湖的絕美全景。
shorts.cta: 造訪 travel4u.us 探索 The Brando 奢華指南

shorts.visual: 棕櫚茅草屋頂別墅隱蔽於綠意盎然的椰林中，倒映於細白如雪的沙灘。
shorts.cta: 造訪 travel4u.us 揭秘 The Brando 前瞻科技

shorts.title: Short 3: Swim with Turtles in Turquoise Lagoon

shorts.visual: 賓客在清澈見底、珊瑚斑斕的水中與海龜溫和悠遊。

en.podcast_title: Episode 46: Mandarin Oriental Bangkok — The 148-Year Legendary Grand Dame Beside the Mother River Chao Phraya
en.soundscape_title: Symphonie du Chao Phraya & Cloches de Siam
en.soundscape_description: The gentle lap of Chao Phraya waves against vintage teakwood hulls, harmonious notes of traditional Thai dulcimers, and the rhythmic breeze of ceiling fans whispering through the Authors’ Lounge.
en.gastronomy_title: Culinary Majesty: Two-Michelin-Starred Le Normandie & Royal Siamese Feasts at Sala Rim Naam
en.gastronomy_dish: The legendary blue lobster bisque flambéed with Cognac at Le Normandie, alongside a fragrant King Crab green curry simmered in fresh coconut cream.
en.wine_pairing: Champagne Krug Grande Cuvée & Fresh Lotus-infused Thai Jasmine Tea
en.positive_emotion: Profound nostalgia paired with legendary hospitality—an unmatched sense of being cherished down to the smallest detail by an iconic butler team.
en.client_concern: The frenzy and heat of Bangkok melt away effortlessly: the grand dame sits gracefully on a serene riverfront, complete with a private fleet of shuttle boats whisking guests seamlessly to the Skytrain and IconSiam.
en.target_persona: Literary connoisseurs, scholars, distinguished global titans, and discerning travelers captivated by Asia's rich cultural heritage.
en.woa_declaration: THIS IS THE ETERNAL MONUMENT OF ASIAN HOSPITALITY — WHERE BUTLER SERVICE ASCENDS TO AN ART FORM!
en.victor_note: Established in 1876, Mandarin Oriental Bangkok (formerly The Oriental) stands as the inaugural luxury hotel of the Kingdom of Siam. It has played host to literary icons including Joseph Conrad, Somerset Maugham, and Noël Coward. With an extraordinary four-to-one staff-to-guest ratio, every whim is anticipated before it is spoken.
en.lucky_note: Indulging in afternoon tea within the sunlit ivory elegance of the Authors’ Lounge—flanked by rattan seats and archival photography—is a quintessential ritual. Be sure to embark on a teakwood boat river crossing to experience traditional Thai herbal remedies at The Oriental Spa, set inside a century-old antique teak house.
critique_positives: Service standards and staff mastery revered globally as best-in-class
The historic Authors’ Wing flawlessly preserves its Victorian colonial splendor
Incomparable riverfront sanctuary paired with an iconic, convenient private shuttle fleet
critique_considerations: The heritage Authors’ Wing houses historic suites exclusively; standard inventory is located within the contemporary River and Garden Wings
Two-Michelin-starred Le Normandie requires dinner reservations at least three weeks in advance

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: Victor, the moment you step into the lobby of Mandarin Oriental Bangkok, the fragrance of fresh lotus blooms and the gentle warmth of your butler's greeting make long-haul travel fatigue evaporate instantly!

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: That is the unmatched lineage of The Oriental, my dear. They have been pampering Siamese royalty and world-renowned literary giants for nearly a century and a half. The staff here will even remember your preferred pillow density and how you take your morning coffee.

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: And sitting riverside as dusk settles, watching wooden riverboats glide past illuminated temple spires... it brings a surreal sense of tranquility.

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: Precisely. Advise our readers to reserve their river-view suites via our Expedia partner link to unlock complimentary riverside breakfast buffets and VIP boat shuttle service passes.

shorts.hook: Thailand's inaugural luxury hotel that welcomed Kings and global literary titans!
shorts.visual: The pristine ivory Victorian grandeur of the Authors' Wing reflected on the windswept Chao Phraya River.
shorts.cta: Explore the Mandarin Oriental guide at travel4u.us

shorts.cta: Discover elite butler services at travel4u.us

zh-tw.podcast_title: 第46集：曼谷文華東方酒店 — 湄南河畔傳承148載的傳奇奢華地標
zh-tw.soundscape_title: 湄南河交響曲與暹羅之鍾 (Symphonie du Chao Phraya & Cloches de Siam)
zh-tw.soundscape_description: 湄南河水輕拂古雅柚木船舷，伴隨泰國傳統揚琴的悠揚樂音，與作家酒廊（Authors’ Lounge）吊扇旋轉帶來的微風交織成詩。
zh-tw.gastronomy_title: 米其林二星 Le Normandie 的巔峰法餐與 Sala Rim Naam 的暹羅皇室饗宴
zh-tw.gastronomy_dish: Le Normandie 經典干邑藍龍蝦濃湯，搭配香濃鮮椰奶慢燉的帝王蟹青咖哩。
zh-tw.wine_pairing: 庫克首選香檳（Champagne Krug Grande Cuvée）與鮮蓮花苞窨製泰式茉莉花茶
zh-tw.positive_emotion: 深沉的懷舊情懷與極致尊榮的傳奇款待（Legendary Hospitality）——由傳奇私人管家團隊貼心呵護至微小細節的無上寵愛。
zh-tw.client_concern: 巧妙化解曼谷的喧囂與悶熱：酒店屹立於寬廣舒懷的湄南河畔，配有專屬奢華柚木船隊，免費接駁賓客至 BTS 空中列車站與 IconSiam 購物中心。
zh-tw.target_persona: 作家、學者、成功企業家，以及沉醉於亞洲歷史文化遺產的品味旅人。
zh-tw.woa_declaration: 此乃亞洲奢華款待精神的永恆殿堂——將尊榮管家服務昇華至藝術之巔！
zh-tw.victor_note: 自 1876 年啟幕以來，曼谷文華東方酒店（前身為 The Oriental）便是暹羅王國的首座奢華酒店，曾接待約瑟夫·康拉德（Joseph Conrad）、毛姆（Somerset Maugham）及諾爾·寇威爾（Noël Coward）等文學巨擘。高達 4 比 1 的員工與客房比例，確保您的需求在開口前已臻完美呈現。
zh-tw.lucky_note: 於作家酒廊（Authors' Lounge）純白典雅的空間中品味英式下午茶，沉浸於藤椅與珍貴歷史影像之中，是不可錯過的經典儀式。切記搭乘柚木古船渡河，前往由百年柚木老宅打造的 The Oriental Spa，體驗古法泰式草本理療。
critique_positives: 卓越絕倫的服務品質與員工培訓，堪稱全球奢華旅宿典範
作家翼（Authors’ Wing）完美保留維多利亞時代殖民風格的優雅風華
得天獨厚尊榮水岸位置，配有便利優雅的專屬柚木接駁船隊
critique_considerations: 典雅古典的作家翼（Authors’ Wing）僅設歷史套房；標準客房位在較為現代的河畔翼（River Wing）與花園翼（Garden Wing）
米其林二星餐廳 Le Normandie 需至少提前 3 週預訂

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: Victor 哥，一踏入曼谷文華東方酒店的大堂，清新蓮花香與管家親切溫暖的微笑，瞬間讓長途飛行後的疲憊煙消雲散！

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: 這就是 The Oriental 的傳奇底蘊。近一個半世紀以來，他們接待過無數暹羅國王與世界級文學巨擘。這裡的員工甚至能精準記住你偏好的枕頭軟硬度與咖啡習慣。

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: 傍晚坐在河畔，看著木舟在輝煌廟宇燈火下輕輕滑過，那種寧靜感真的無與倫比！

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: 一點也沒錯。建議讀者透過我們合作的 Expedia 連結預訂河景客房，即可尊享免費河畔自助早餐與 VIP 專屬接駁船票。

shorts.title: Short 1: 曼谷 148 載歷史傳奇奢華地標
shorts.hook: 泰國首座接待過帝王與全球文學巨擘的傳奇酒店！
shorts.visual: 作家翼（Authors' Wing）純白典雅的建築倒映在微風吹拂的湄南河面。
shorts.cta: 前往 travel4u.us 探索文華東方奢華指南

shorts.title: Short 2: 泰式管家服務的極致藝術
shorts.hook: 曼谷極致奢華標竿：高達 4 比 1 的尊榮管家配比！
shorts.visual: 身著傳統白色制服的管家優雅地將鮮蓮花茶與熱帶時蔬水果奉至套房內。
shorts.cta: 登入 travel4u.us 探索尊榮服務細節

shorts.title: Short 3: 百年柚木老宅水上 Spa
shorts.hook: 搭乘專屬柚木古船渡河，在百年老宅中享受經典芳療！
shorts.visual: 古雅的柚木船停靠於綠意盎然的 The Oriental Spa 碼頭。
shorts.cta: 前往 travel4u.us 獲取合作夥伴專屬預訂連結

en.podcast_title: Episode 45: Hôtel de Paris Monte-Carlo — The Epicentre of High Society on Casino Square
en.soundscape_title: Symphony of Marble & Legendary Engines
en.soundscape_description: The crystalline clinking of glasses at Le Bar Américain weaves seamlessly with classic jazz piano and the exhilarated roar of supercars gliding across Place du Casino.
en.gastronomy_title: Three-Michelin-Starred Pinnacle: Le Louis XV by Legendary Chef Alain Ducasse
en.gastronomy_dish: Mediterranean sea bass with crisp fennel and Menton citrus essence, alongside Alain Ducasse's signature Riviera garden vegetables in a rich black truffle reduction.
en.wine_pairing: Champagne Dom Pérignon P2 paired with rare vintages from the subterranean cellar housing over 350,000 bottles—the largest hotel wine collection in the world.
en.positive_emotion: An unmatched sense of sovereign power and royal grandeur—immersed in the heart of European aristocracy, glittering supercars, and the world's most opulent casino.
en.client_concern: Any apprehension regarding the bustle of Casino Square is effortlessly dispelled by state-of-the-art acoustic glazing, ensuring a serene sanctuary at the very epicenter of Monaco.
en.target_persona: Global billionaires, Formula 1 Grand Prix aficionados, and discerning high-net-worth travellers enamoured with the regal Monégasque lifestyle.
en.woa_declaration: THE ETERNAL ICON OF EUROPEAN LUXURY—WHERE EVERY ARISTOCRATIC REVERIE MANIFESTS INTO REALITY!
en.victor_note: Inaugurated in 1864 under the grand vision of Prince Charles III, Hôtel de Paris commands the most coveted address on Earth: directly on Place du Casino. In the lobby, the bronze hoof of King Louis XIV’s equestrian statue gleams brightly, polished by generations of guests seeking fortune. Meanwhile, dining at Alain Ducasse’s Le Louis XV remains the absolute zenith of French haute cuisine.
en.lucky_note: The ultimate insider secret: The rooftop Prince Rainier III Suite features a private infinity pool directly overlooking the legendary F1 Grand Prix hairpin turn and Port Hercule filled with megayachts. Booking via our Expedia partner link grants exclusive privileges, including access to Thermes Marins Monte-Carlo and its heated seawater pool facing the Mediterranean.
critique_positives: Unrivalled world-class location adjacent to Casino de Monte-Carlo and Opéra de Monte-Carlo
Alain Ducasse's three-Michelin-starred Le Louis XV, maintaining legendary culinary excellence for over three decades
Les Caves de l'Hôtel de Paris—a subterranean cellar carved into rock, guarding over 350,000 priceless bottles
critique_considerations: During May's Monaco F1 Grand Prix, the property fully books a year in advance with record peak rates
Formal evening attire (jacket & tie) is strictly required for dinner at Le Louis XV

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: Victor, standing on the balcony of Hôtel de Paris, watching the fleet of Ferraris and Rolls-Royces lined up outside Place du Casino as the lights illuminate the square... it's utterly breathtaking!

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: That is precisely why royalty and high society consider this their home on the Riviera, my dear. Deep beneath our feet lies a cellar housing 350,000 vintage bottles—the largest hotel wine collection on Earth.

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: And Alain Ducasse's three-Michelin-starred dining at Le Louis XV... every gilded detail on the ceiling and the freshly plucked herbal tea trolley showcase flawless perfection.

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: Indubitably. Remind our readers to reserve early via our Expedia partner link to secure oceanfront accommodations and priority Michelin table bookings.

shorts.hook: Inside Monaco's grandest palace hotel, where billionaires retreat after an evening at the casino!
shorts.visual: Opulent marble lobby adorned with King Louis XIV's bronze equestrian statue and glittering crystal chandeliers.

shorts.hook: Hidden deep beneath the earth lies a vault holding 350,000 of the world's rarest vintages!
shorts.visual: A master sommelier guiding through ancient stone corridors lined with priceless bottles.

zh-tw.podcast_title: 第 45 集：蒙特卡洛巴黎大飯店 — 賭場廣場中心，極致豪門的蔚藍海岸傳奇
zh-tw.soundscape_title: 大理石交響曲與傳奇引擎狂想
zh-tw.soundscape_description: Le Bar Américain 水晶高腳杯交織出的清脆輕響，伴隨經典爵士鋼琴旋律，與賭場廣場上頂級超跑低沉迴盪的引擎聲交織成絕美樂章。
zh-tw.gastronomy_title: 米其林三星美饌之巔：傳奇名廚 Alain Ducasse 的 Le Louis XV
zh-tw.gastronomy_dish: 地中海海鱸魚佐酥脆茴香與蒙頓柑橘精萃，搭配 Alain Ducasse 招牌里維拉莊園時蔬佐黑松露濃汁。
zh-tw.wine_pairing: Dom Pérignon P2 尊榮香檳，配以來自全球最大飯店地下酒窖（藏酒逾 350,000 瓶）的稀世名釀。
zh-tw.positive_emotion: 至高無上的皇者威儀與尊榮感受（Monaco Royal Sovereign）— 置身於歐洲頂尖貴族、炫目超跑與全歐最奢華賭場交織的核心之地。
zh-tw.client_concern: 無需擔心賭場廣場的喧囂，尖端高科技隔音玻璃將嘈雜阻隔在外，讓您在摩納哥的最核心地帶獨享極致清幽。
zh-tw.target_persona: 全球億萬富豪、一級方程式賽車（F1 Grand Prix）頂級影迷，以及沉醉於摩納哥宮廷式奢華生活的層峰人士。
zh-tw.woa_declaration: 歐洲奢華帝國的不朽圖騰 — 一切貴族式綺麗夢想皆在此化為現實！
zh-tw.victor_note: 自 1864 年依據查爾斯三世親王（Prince Charles III）的宏偉願景啟幕以來，蒙特卡洛巴黎大飯店便霸氣踞守於全球最尊貴的地段：賭場廣場正中央。大廳內路易十四青銅騎馬像的馬蹄亮光閃閃，皆因無數賓客深信撫摸它能帶來幸運。而於 Alain Ducasse 執掌的 Le Louis XV 享用晚宴，無疑是法式頂級法餐（Haute Cuisine）的終極殿堂標竿。
zh-tw.lucky_note: 頂級奢華秘境：位於頂樓的雷尼爾三世親王套房（Prince Rainier III Suite）擁有私人無邊際泳池，直面 F1 大獎賽傳奇彎道與停滿巨型超級遊艇的赫庫勒港（Port Hercule）。透過 Expedia 合作夥伴鏈結預訂，可享有獨家尊榮禮遇，包括前往 Thermes Marins Monte-Carlo 溫水海水泳池，盡覽地中海壯麗景致。
critique_positives: 無與倫比的世界頂級地段，毗鄰蒙特卡洛大賭場與加尼葉歌劇院
Alain Ducasse 執掌的三星米其林餐廳 Le Louis XV，三十餘載屹立於美饌巔峰
Les Caves de l’Hôtel de Paris 岩石酒窖，深鑿於地下，珍藏逾 350,000 瓶稀世名釀
critique_considerations: 每年五月摩納哥 F1 大獎賽期間，全館提前一年即告售罄，房價更創下新高
於 Le Louis XV 享用晚宴須恪守正裝禮儀（男性需穿著西裝外套並佩帶領帶）

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: Victor，站在蒙特卡洛巴黎大飯店的陽台上，看著法拉利與勞斯萊斯在廣場前一字排開，伴隨著蒙特卡洛賭場璀璨的燈光……這種震撼感簡直令人窒息！

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: 這正是為何各國皇室與頂級富豪皆將此處視為地中海的第二個家。沉睡於我們腳底深處的地下酒窖珍藏著 350,000 瓶佳釀，是全球各大飯店中規模最大的酒窖。

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: 還有 Alain Ducasse 在 Le Louis XV 呈現的三星米其林美饌……從天花板上金碧輝煌的雕飾到新鮮香草茶推車，每一處細節都展現出無可挑剔的完美。

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: 一點也不錯。請務必提醒讀者透過 Expedia 合作夥伴鏈結提早預訂，以確保獲得海景房型與頂級米其林餐廳的優先訂位。

en.podcast_title: Episode 47: Cheval Blanc St-Barth — LVMH’s Exclusive Coastal Palace
en.soundscape_title: Symphonie des Flamands & Brise Alizée
en.soundscape_description: The crescendo of white-capped surf along Anse des Flamands harmoniously weaves with Caribbean trade winds rustling through palm fronds, anchored by the sultry, melodious bossa nova echoing from La Cabane.
en.gastronomy_title: Haute French-Caribbean Culinary Artistry at La Case
en.gastronomy_dish: Spiced Atlantic grouper infused with Caribbean island aromatics, an indulgent avocado-lobster salad, and an equatorial chocolate ganache confection orchestrated by Master Chef Jean Imbert.
en.wine_pairing: Moët & Chandon Grand Vintage Champagne alongside aged Antillean Rhum Agricole artisanal cocktails.
en.positive_emotion: The ultimate expression of 'Barefoot Couture'—the sublime sensation of strolling barefoot across powdery sands clad in LVMH’s finest silk resort wear.
en.client_concern: Any lingering misgiving regarding St-Barth’s ostentatious buzz melts away: Cheval Blanc sits secluded along the pristine crescent of Anse des Flamands, home to the island’s gentlest swells and most unspoiled sands.
en.target_persona: Global fashion icons, visionary creative directors, discerning tycoons, and refined couples seeking the Atlantic's most coveted tropical sanctuary.
en.woa_declaration: THIS IS THE CARIBBEAN'S MOST EXQUISITE COASTAL SANCTUARY — THE PINNACLE OF FRENCH ART DE VIVRE!
en.victor_note: As the sole resort in the Caribbean distinguished with the official French 'Palace' designation, Cheval Blanc St-Barth stands as a design masterpiece by renowned architect Jacques Grange. Signature coral pink and taupe hues merge seamlessly with bleached oak and raw linen, forging an ambiance that is at once intimately warm and undeniably regal.
en.lucky_note: The oceanfront five-bedroom Villa de France, featuring a private infinity pool kissing the water's edge, represents the zenith of coastal luxury. Meanwhile, the region's sole Cheval Blanc Spa offers bespoke Guerlain rituals and elixirs. Reserve via our Expedia partner link to secure complimentary private airport transfers from Gustaf III Airport and daily beachside breakfast.
critique_positives: The sole Caribbean retreat honoured with France's prestigious 'Palace' distinction
Set upon Anse des Flamands—the island's most expansive bay boasting crystalline powdery white sands
An exclusive Guerlain Spa enveloped by lush tropical gardens offering bespoke olfactory wellness rituals
critique_considerations: Annual seasonal closure from September to mid-October during the Atlantic hurricane season
St-Barth’s notoriously brief airstrip requires arrival via small turboprop aircraft, delivering an exhilarating micro-adventure

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: Victor, walking barefoot across the pristine white sands of Flamands Bay, surrounded by Cheval Blanc's elegant coral pink parasols... I am experiencing the ultimate French art de vivre right in the heart of the Caribbean!

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: That is because every single touchpoint bears the imprint of Bernard Arnault and Jacques Grange. From the bespoke 'Tropical Chic' ambient fragrance crafted by Guerlain’s Thierry Wasser to the intuitive Alchimiste butler service anticipating your every whim.

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: And that beachfront lunch at La Cabane—grilled local fish paired with a chilled glass of rosé while my feet dipped in the soft sand... Simply perfection.

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: Indeed. Remind our listeners to book via our Expedia partner link to unlock preferred beachfront room placement and exclusive Guerlain welcome gifts.

zh-tw.podcast_title: 第47集：聖巴泰勒米白馬莊園 — LVMH集團旗下奢華獨佔的海濱法式宮殿
zh-tw.soundscape_title: Symphonie des Flamands & Brise Alizée
zh-tw.soundscape_description: Flamands海灘捲起層層雪白浪花，與輕拂棕櫚樹梢的加勒比貿易風交織成韻，間或融入La Cabane餐廳隨風繚繞的柔和波薩諾瓦（Bossa Nova）旋律。
zh-tw.gastronomy_title: La Case餐廳的頂級法式加勒比法式美饌
zh-tw.gastronomy_dish: 由主廚 Jean Imbert 匠心締造，炙烤加勒比香料石斑魚肉質細嫩，搭佐濃郁奶油酪梨龍蝦沙拉，最終以赤道可可甘納許甜點完美收尾。
zh-tw.wine_pairing: 銘悅年份香檳（Moët & Chandon Grand Vintage）與安地列斯群島陳年農業甘蔗蘭姆酒調酒。
zh-tw.positive_emotion: 極致優雅的「赤腳高訂」（Barefoot Couture）悠閒意境——身著 LVMH 集團頂級絲綢度假服飾，赤腳漫步於細白沙灘上的隨性與雍容。
zh-tw.client_concern: 關於聖巴泰勒米島過度嘈雜張揚的疑慮迎刃而解：白馬莊園隱逸於恬靜的 Flamands 灣，擁有全島最平緩柔和的浪潮與最純淨無暇的白沙。
zh-tw.target_persona: 國際時尚指標、創意總監、頂尖富豪以及尋求大西洋最頂級熱帶奢華避世之旅的品味伴侶。
zh-tw.woa_declaration: 這裏是加勒比海最奢華頂級的海濱度假天堂 — 法式生活藝術的最高境界！
zh-tw.victor_note: 作為加勒比海地區唯一榮獲法國官方尊榮「Palace（宮殿級）」認證的渡假村，聖巴泰勒米白馬莊園是傳奇設計師 Jacques Grange 的建築美學傑作。標誌性的珊瑚粉與灰褐色調，巧妙融合白橡木與天然亞麻，打造出既溫馨又極具尊貴氣度的海濱殿堂。
zh-tw.lucky_note: 擁有五間客房與臨海私人無邊際泳池的海濱 Villa de France 奢華別墅，是奢華度假的頂峰之作。全加勒比海唯一的 Cheval Blanc Spa 則全程採用嬌蘭（Guerlain）獨家尊榮療程與產品。請務必透過我們的 Expedia 合作連結預訂，即可享有 Gustaf III 機場專屬專車接送與每日海灘早餐尊榮禮遇。
critique_positives: 全加勒比海地區唯一榮膺法國最高榮譽「Palace 宮殿級」認證的奢華渡假村
坐擁全島最寬廣的 Flamands 灣，獨享綿延絕美的細白沙灘
隱匿於熱帶花園中的獨家嬌蘭（Guerlain）Spa，提供頂級香氛芳療體驗
critique_considerations: 渡假村於每年9月至10月中旬的大西洋颶風季期間暫停營業
聖巴泰勒米機場跑道極短，需搭乘小型螺旋槳飛機降落，帶來充滿驚險刺激的獨特降落體驗

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: Victor，赤腳漫步在 Flamands 灣細白沙灘上，看著白馬莊園精緻的珊瑚粉陽傘... 我在這裡深刻體會到了沉浸於加勒比海中的法式頂級奢華生活方式！

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: 這是因為這裡的每一個細節都烙印著 Bernard Arnault 與 Jacques Grange 的美學靈魂。從調香大師 Thierry Wasser 為房間調製的 'Tropical Chic' 獨家香氛，到 Alchimiste 貼身管家團隊無微不至的專屬服務。

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: 還有在 La Cabane 享用炙烤鮮魚搭配冰鎮粉紅葡萄酒，雙腳輕觸細軟白沙... 這真的是最完美的度假體驗！

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: 完全正確。請記得提醒聽眾透過我們的 Expedia 合作夥伴連結預訂，即可享有優先海景房型安排與專屬嬌蘭迎賓禮。

en.podcast_title: Episode 48: Hôtel du Cap-Eden-Roc — The Legendary Sanctuary of Cannes’ Screen Icons
en.soundscape_title: Symphonie des Falaises & Vagues d’Azur
en.soundscape_description: The rhythmic cadence of Mediterranean waves crashing against majestic basalt cliffs, intertwined with joyful laughter around the Eden-Roc pool and the gentle whisper of sea breezes through 150-year-old umbrella pines.
en.gastronomy_title: Culinary Mastery on the Riviera by Chef Sébastien Broda
en.gastronomy_dish: Guérande sea salt-crusted sea bream served with braised purple artichokes and lemongrass, pan-seared foie gras, and wild woodland strawberries with Tahitian vanilla cream.
en.wine_pairing: Champagne Dom Pérignon Vintage & Domaine Ott Château Romassan Rosé
en.positive_emotion: A profound sense of Eternal Glamour—strolling along pine-shaded alleyways where F. Scott Fitzgerald penned literary masterworks and Pablo Picasso captured the Riviera light.
en.client_concern: Any apprehensions regarding paparazzi intrusion during the Cannes Film Festival are entirely dispelled: the hotel resides on a private, heavily fortified 9-hectare peninsula offering absolute security and discretion.
en.target_persona: Hollywood luminaries, Oscar-winning auteurs, European industrial dynasties, and discerning luxury connoisseurs seeking France’s ultimate icon of hospitality.
en.woa_declaration: THE UNDISPUTED ICON OF THE CÔTE D’AZUR — A TIMELESS MASTERPIECE OF ETERNAL GLAMOUR!
en.victor_note: Since opening its doors in 1870, Hôtel du Cap-Eden-Roc has defined the quintessential High Society summer. Carved directly into the basalt cliffs in 1914 by a visionary architect, the saltwater infinity pool remains the most iconic silhouette in the entirety of the Côte d’Azur. Tucked within the pine grove, 33 historic cabanas have long served as private creative sanctuaries for literary giants and legendary filmmakers.
en.lucky_note: Leaping from the iconic wooden diving board straight into the crystal-clear azure waters of the Mediterranean is a cherished rite of passage for the global elite. The lavish buffet lunch at Eden-Roc Grill, overlooking the Lérins Islands, is arguably the most breathtaking dining setting on earth. Reserve well in advance via our Expedia partner link to secure coveted oceanfront suites and private cabana access.
critique_positives: A sprawling 22-acre estate shaded by centuries-old pine trees, offering absolute privacy and high-level security.
The legendary saltwater pool sculpted directly into basalt cliffs—widely celebrated as the most famous hotel pool in history.
33 historic, utterly exclusive wooden cabanas nestled within a secluded coastal pine forest.
critique_considerations: Operates seasonally from mid-April through mid-October; fully booked over a year in advance during the Cannes Film Festival (May).
Strictly accepts credit card or advance wire transfer payments; upholds an impeccably traditional and formal service etiquette.

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: Victor, walking down the stone-paved Allée des Pins toward the sea, taking in that cliffside pool carved straight into the basalt rock... I feel like I've stepped right onto the pages of The Great Gatsby!

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: Spot on, my dear. F. Scott Fitzgerald actually modeled the resort in Tender Is the Night on Eden-Roc itself. It has been the sanctuary of choice for screen legends from Audrey Hepburn and Elizabeth Taylor to Leonardo DiCaprio.

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: And that sensation of diving straight off the cliffside board into the azure sea... It's pure, unadulterated freedom!

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: Indeed. I urge our listeners to plan early and book via our Expedia partner link to guarantee oceanfront suites and secure access to these storied cabanas.

zh-tw.podcast_title: 第48集：Hôtel du Cap-Eden-Roc — 坎城巨星與名流的傳奇避世之所
zh-tw.soundscape_title: 懸崖與蔚藍波濤的大自然交響曲 (Symphonie des Falaises & Vagues d’Azur)
zh-tw.soundscape_description: 地中海浪濤拍打著雄偉玄武岩峭壁的沉穩節奏，交織著 Eden-Roc 泳池畔的歡聲笑語，以及海風輕撫 150 年百年傘松樹梢的沙沙聲響。
zh-tw.gastronomy_title: 主廚 Sébastien Broda 的蔚藍海岸極致海鮮美饌
zh-tw.gastronomy_dish: 葛蘭德 (Guérande) 鹽之花烤海鱸魚佐香茅燉紫芋頭、香煎鵝肝，以及搭配大溪地香草奶霜的野草莓甜點。
zh-tw.wine_pairing: 香檳王 Dom Pérignon Vintage 與 蝶雅答城堡 Château Romassan 玫瑰紅酒
zh-tw.positive_emotion: 不朽的璀璨魅力（Eternal Glamour）— 漫步於松林蔭道，踩著費茲傑羅曾構思小說、畢卡索曾寫生描繪的傳奇足跡。
zh-tw.client_concern: 坎城影展期間對狗仔隊騷擾的疑慮可完全消除：飯店獨佔 9 公頃獨立半島，提供蔚藍海岸最嚴密的安保與絕對隱私。
zh-tw.target_persona: 好萊塢巨星、奧斯卡金獎導演、歐洲頂尖名門望族，以及尋求法國極致奢華象徵的高品味隱世貴賓。
zh-tw.woa_declaration: 蔚藍海岸無可替代的傳奇地標 — 跨越歲月洗禮的永恆奢華傑作！
zh-tw.victor_note: 自 1870 年開幕以來，Hôtel du Cap-Eden-Roc 便定義了全球頂級名流的夏日度假方式。1914 年由傳奇建築師直接於玄武岩峭壁上鑿建的海水泳池，至今仍是蔚藍海岸最具代表性的畫面。隱匿於海濱松林中的 33 座歷史 Cabana 木屋，更是文壇巨擘與傳奇導演靈感迸發的避世聖地。
zh-tw.lucky_note: 從懸崖上的木質跳板躍入地中海晶瑩剔透的水波之中，是頂級新貴的經典儀式。在俯瞰萊蘭群島（Lérins Islands）的 Eden-Roc Grill 享用自助午餐，堪稱全球最美午宴景致。建議盡早透過 Expedia 合作夥伴連結預訂，優先確保海景套房與專屬 Cabana 使用權。
critique_positives: 佔地 22 英畝的古松園林，提供軍規級的高規格安全防禦與極致隱私
開鑿於玄武岩峭壁上的海水泳池，被譽為旅宿史上最著名的傳奇泳池
33 座隱匿於海濱松林中的歷史 Cabana 木屋，極具獨特性與傳奇色彩
critique_considerations: 採季節性營運（每年 4 月中旬至 10 月中旬）；5 月坎城影展期間客房需提前一年預訂
僅接受信用卡或事前電匯付款；極為注重並堅持極致傳統且尊榮的頂級服務禮儀

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: Victor 哥，漫步在直通大海的 Allée des Pins 石板大道上，遠眺開鑿於玄武岩峭壁上的 Eden-Roc 泳池... 我感覺自己彷彿走進了《大亨小傳》的經典頁面！

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: 一點也不假。費茲傑羅正是以 Eden-Roc 為原型，寫下了《夜未央》中的傳奇飯店。從奧黛麗赫本、伊莉莎白泰勒到李奧納多狄卡皮歐，這裡始終是巨星們的隱世首選。

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: 而且從懸崖跳板直接躍入蔚藍大海的那一刻... 那種酣暢淋漓的自由感簡直無法言喻！

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: 確實如此。建議各位聽眾提早規劃，透過我們的 Expedia 合作夥伴連結預訂，鎖定夢幻海景套房並尊享歷史 Cabana 木屋體驗。

shorts.title: Short 1：全球最著名的懸崖海景泳池

en.podcast_title: Episode 49: Nihi Sumba — An Untamed Sanctuary Where Cresting Swells and Wild Horses Reign
en.soundscape_title: Tonnerre d’Occy & Galop des Chevaux Sauvages
en.soundscape_description: The thunderous roar of the legendary Occy’s Left wave intertwined with the rhythmic gallop of Sandalwood steeds across 2.5 kilometres of pristine white sand, punctuated by the resonant, timeless prayers of Sumba villagers.
en.gastronomy_title: Coastal Epicurean Wilderness & Sumba’s Organic Abundance
en.gastronomy_dish: Flame-kissed yellowfin tuna wrapped in fragrant banana leaves over coconut charcoal, paired with a zesty green papaya salad steeped in local chili, followed by a rich Sumba beef curry infused with indigenous aromatics.
en.wine_pairing: Crisp New Zealand Sauvignon Blanc & Chilled, freshly harvested forest coconut water
en.positive_emotion: Untamed Freedom — a primal, transcendent communion with raw wilderness and the majestic power of the open ocean.
en.client_concern: Any lingering apprehensions of remote isolation disappear upon arrival: each thatched-roof villa boasts refined air-conditioning, a private plunge pool, and dedicated, intuitive personal butler service.
en.target_persona: High-net-worth surf aficionados, discerning eco-connoisseurs, and affluent families seeking transformative adventure combined with impactful philanthropy via the Sumba Foundation.
en.woa_declaration: THIS IS ASIA’S MOST UNTOUCHED PARADISE — WHERE YOU RECLAIM YOUR TRULY UNTAMED SELF!
en.victor_note: Twice crowned the World’s Best Hotel by Travel + Leisure, Nihi Sumba transcends traditional luxury—it is an ethereal philosophy of living. Perched on the mysterious southern coast of Sumba, it caps access to its famed wave, Occy’s Left, to a mere 10 surfers per day. Galloping along the tide line at golden hour remains one of life’s most utterly breathtaking triumphs.
en.lucky_note: The crown jewel experience here is the Nihi Oka Spa Safari: a scenic trek through emerald rice terraces and tribal hamlets to a secluded peninsula, where limitless all-day body treatments await in clifftop bamboo pavilions overlooking crashing swells. Reserve via our Expedia luxury partner link to guarantee your exclusive surf slot and village cultural excursion.
critique_positives: Exclusive access to the iconic Occy’s Left wave, capped strictly for an unrivaled, uncrowded surf experience.
The world’s only full-day Nihi Oka Spa Safari, offering private clifftop wellness bliss.
Deeply meaningful social impact, with a significant share of profits funding clean water and medical care for local Sumbanese communities.
critique_considerations: Requires a 50-minute domestic flight from Bali to Tambolaka Airport, followed by a 90-minute scenic overland drive through rugged jungle terrain.
The open ocean surf along the main stretch is powerful; young children are best suited to private villa plunge pools or sheltered coastal coves.

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: Victor, galloping along a 2.5-kilometer untamed shore on Sandalwood steeds as the sun dips into the sea... the sheer sense of unbounded freedom at Nihi Sumba brought me to tears!

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: That is because Nihi Sumba resides on the edge of the known world, my dear. It safeguards the primordial soul of the earth. And the Nihi Oka Spa Safari—receiving massages atop high cliffs to the symphony of breaking waves—is a once-in-a-lifetime indulgence.

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: Not to mention the legendary Occy’s Left... a sacred pilgrimage site for surfers across the globe!

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: Precisely. Do remind our audience to book early through our Expedia partner link to secure their surf slot and coveted Spa Safari pass.

zh-tw.podcast_title: 第49集：Nihi Sumba — 巨浪與野馬共舞的荒野奢華綠洲
zh-tw.soundscape_title: Tonnerre d’Occy & Galop des Chevaux Sauvages（Occy巨浪雷霆與野馬奔騰）
zh-tw.soundscape_description: 傳奇巨浪 Occy’s Left 咆哮轟鳴的磅礡濤聲，交織著 Sandalwood 純種馬在2.5公里綿延白沙灘上奔騰的踏沙蹄響，伴隨松巴島原住民部落悠遠虔誠的祈禱吟唱。
zh-tw.gastronomy_title: 海岸野性饗宴與松巴島有機農場的精緻薈萃
zh-tw.gastronomy_dish: 現捕黃鰭鮪魚裹香蕉葉以椰殼炭火慢烤，佐以酸辣提味的青木瓜沙拉，以及濃郁滿溢在地香料氣息的松巴燉牛肉。
zh-tw.wine_pairing: 紐西蘭清冽白蘇維濃白酒 (Sauvignon Blanc) 與 現採原汁清甜野椰子水
zh-tw.positive_emotion: 原始不羈的極致自由 (Untamed Freedom) —— 感受與壯闊大自然及浩瀚大海力量的純粹連結。
zh-tw.client_concern: 對偏遠孤島與設施簡陋的疑慮隨即煙消雲散：每座傳統茅草頂別墅均配備現代冷氣、私人游泳池，以及無微不至的在地貼身管家服務。
zh-tw.target_persona: 層峰衝浪者、極致野奢探險家，以及渴望結合野性冒險與松巴基金會 (Sumba Foundation) 慈善公益的頂級家庭。
zh-tw.woa_declaration: 這是亞洲最令人屏息的世外桃源 —— 在這裡，您將找回靈魂中最純粹不羈的自由！
zh-tw.victor_note: 兩度榮獲《Travel + Leisure》評選為「全球最佳飯店」，Nihi Sumba 不僅是一座頂級渡假村，更是一種奢華生活哲學。座落於神秘松巴島的南部海岸，這裡對夢幻名浪 Occy’s Left 實施極致嚴格的人數管制，每天僅限10位衝浪者下水。黃昏時分騎著駿馬沿著潮線奔馳，無疑是人生中最震撼心靈的絕美體驗之一。
zh-tw.lucky_note: 這裡最極致的頂級體驗莫過於 Nihi Oka Spa Safari：徒步穿過翠綠梯田與原住民村落，抵達一座隱世懸崖半島，在臨海竹亭中享有無限量全天候 SPA 療程，俯瞰巨浪拍岸。建議透過 Expedia 合作夥伴預訂，即可享尊榮獨家衝浪名額保障與部落文化導覽。
critique_positives: 傳奇巨浪 Occy’s Left 獨家專屬控管，每日嚴格限額，確保極致無干擾的衝浪體驗。
全球唯一的全日 Nihi Oka Spa Safari，於懸崖之巔享受無與倫比的隱密養生體驗。
深具意義的社會貢獻：將大部分營利投入松巴島當地社區，提供乾淨水源與醫療資源。
critique_considerations: 需自峇里島搭乘約50分鐘國內線航班至 Tambolaka 機場，再轉乘約90分鐘車程穿越南洋叢林山脈。
主海灘的海浪較為強勁；建議兒童於別墅私人泳池或平靜的海灣區域玩水。

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: Victor 哥，黃昏時分騎著 Sandalwood 駿馬，在長達2.5公里的原始沙灘上縱情奔馳…… Nihi Sumba 那種極致自由與不羈的感覺，真的讓我感動到哽咽！

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: 因為 Nihi Sumba 就位在現代文明的盡頭啊。這裡完好地封存了天地間最原始的靈魂。還有 Nihi Oka Spa Safari……在懸崖峭壁上聆聽浪濤聲接受按摩，絕對是獨一無二的奢華享受。

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: 還有那傳奇的 Occy’s Left 巨浪……全世界衝浪愛好者心中的神聖殿堂！

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: 沒錯。別忘了提醒聽眾提早透過 Expedia 合作連結預訂，優先鎖定限量衝浪席位與 Spa Safari 尊榮體驗。

en.podcast_title: Episode 50: One&Only Reethi Rah Maldives — Sovereign Splendour Across 12 Coral Shores
en.soundscape_title: Symphonie du Lagon & Brise des Alizés
en.soundscape_description: Gentle lagoon waves lapping against overwater villa stilts, harmonising with the rustle of tropical palm fronds and the subtle clink of crystal champagne flutes on a yacht deck at twilight.
en.gastronomy_title: Peak Multicultural Haute Cuisine Across 7 Fine-Dining Sanctuaries
en.gastronomy_dish: A5 Wagyu beef seared on volcanic hot stones overwater at Tapasake, followed by fragrant embers-grilled seafood platters served seaside at Fanditha.
en.wine_pairing: Champagne Louis Roederer Cristal & A Private Collection of Grand Cru White Burgundies
en.positive_emotion: Unbridled Epicurean Freedom — the sense of commanding a vast, sovereign tropical realm with 12 private beaches where one never encounters a crowd.
en.client_concern: The lingering apprehension of resort island confinement is effortlessly dispelled: Reethi Rah is among the archipelago's grandest coral islands, spanning 6 kilometres of private coastline where each guest enjoys a bespoke bicycle for endless exploration.
en.target_persona: Ultra-high-net-worth families, celebratory couples, elite athletes, and global luminaries seeking the world's quintessential tropical hideaway.
en.woa_declaration: THIS IS THE MALDIVES' MOST RADIANT ISLAND PARADISE — WHERE 12 PRIVATE BEACHES BELONG EXCLUSIVELY TO US!
en.victor_note: Masterminded by visionary architect Jean-Michel Gathy, One&Only Reethi Rah remains the enduring paragon of Maldivian luxury. Designed like an octopus with sweeping peninsulas, the island yields 12 secluded coves of powdery white sand. The iconic Grand Water Villa, featuring a 20-metre infinity pool suspended over turquoise lagoon waters, defines the art of sublime indulgence.
en.lucky_note: An intimate candlelit dining experience on plush Persian rugs at Fanditha as the crimson sun sinks into the Indian Ocean is pure enchantment. The overwater treatment pavilions and warm hydrotherapy pools at One&Only Spa offer absolute rejuvenation. Book via our preferred partner Expedia to secure complimentary luxury yacht transfers from Malé Airport.
critique_positives: Staggering island scale featuring 12 private beaches and 6 kilometres of immaculate coral coastline.
Architecturally grand villas with soaring vaulted ceilings and amongst the most generous footprints in the Maldives.
Effortless 45-minute luxury catamaran transfer directly from Velana International Airport.
critique_considerations: Given the island's vast geography, traversing between dining venues and villas requires a leisurely cycle or a buggy service.
Prime overwater seating at coveted venues like Tapasake and Botanica necessitates advance reservations.

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: Victor, cycling beneath lush palm canopies and gliding past 12 pristine white sand beaches without seeing a single soul... Reethi Rah delivers a grand sense of spatial luxury quite unlike any other Maldivian resort!

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: That is the architectural brilliance of Jean-Michel Gathy. He transformed this island into an unbound tropical sanctuary. The Grand Sunset Residence here has hosted some of the world's most distinguished dynasties.

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: And that sunset dinner suspended over the lagoon at Tapasake... Volcanic stone-seared Wagyu paired with a chilled glass of Cristal champagne—it is truly paradise on earth!

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: Precisely. Remind our listeners to book through our official Expedia partner link to receive complimentary luxury yacht transfers and VIP spa privileges.

zh-tw.podcast_title: 第 50 集：馬爾地夫 One&Only Reethi Rah — 坐擁 12 座珊瑚沙灘的尊榮王者之境
zh-tw.soundscape_title: 潟湖交響曲與信風輕拂 (Symphonie du Lagon & Brise des Alizés)
zh-tw.soundscape_description: 微波拍打水上別墅木柱的輕柔聲響，與熱帶棕櫚葉的沙沙聲交織，伴隨著黃昏時分豪華遊艇甲板上水晶香檳杯的清亮碰杯聲。
zh-tw.gastronomy_title: 7 間頂級美饌餐廳交織出的跨文化奢華饗宴
zh-tw.gastronomy_dish: Tapasake 水上日式餐廳的火山熔岩石炙烤 A5 和牛，以及 Fanditha 海濱沙灘邊香氣四溢的炭烤海鮮拼盤。
zh-tw.wine_pairing: 路易高妃水晶香檳 (Champagne Louis Roederer Cristal) 與布根地特級園 (Grand Cru) 白葡萄酒珍藏系列
zh-tw.positive_emotion: 無拘無束的享樂自由 (Epicurean Freedom) —— 獨佔龐大的熱帶島嶼與 12 座私密沙灘，完全遠離世俗喧囂的終極奢華體驗。
zh-tw.client_concern: 完美化解對小型馬爾地夫度假島嶼空間幽閉感的疑慮：Reethi Rah 為馬爾地夫規模最大的珊瑚島之一，擁有長達 6 公里的海岸線，每位賓客皆獲贈專屬單車供自由探索。
zh-tw.target_persona: 頂級名流家族、慶祝紀念日的高雅情侶、頂尖運動員及尋求全球頂級熱帶避世之所的國際巨星。
zh-tw.woa_declaration: 這是馬爾地夫最璀璨耀眼的島嶼天堂 —— 12 座私密沙灘皆為我們獨家專屬！
zh-tw.victor_note: 由傳奇建築大師 Jean-Michel Gathy 親自操刀，One&Only Reethi Rah 是馬爾地夫永恆的奢華標竿。章魚造型的島嶼輪廓延伸出多座海角，勾勒出 12 座宛如細粉般的純白彎月沙灘。其經典的水上豪宅 Grand Water Villa 擁有懸浮於蔚藍潟湖之上的 20 公尺無邊際泳池，堪稱極致奢華享受的定義之作。
zh-tw.lucky_note: 在阿拉伯餐廳 Fanditha 鋪設於細沙上的波斯軟墊上，伴隨燭光享用浪漫晚餐，凝視深紅落日漸漸沉入印度洋，是不可思議的神聖時刻。One&Only Spa 的水上按摩亭與溫水水療池則是煥活身心的極致聖地。建議透過 Expedia 官方合作夥伴預訂，即可尊享馬累機場的豪華雙體遊艇免費接送服務。
critique_positives: 宏偉的島嶼規模，獨佔 12 座私密沙灘與 6 公里絕美珊瑚海岸線。
別墅採用高聳挑高的穹頂設計，擁有馬爾地夫最為寬敞大氣的奢華空間。
從韋拉納國際機場搭乘奢華雙體遊艇僅需 45 分鐘即可優雅抵達。
critique_considerations: 由於島嶼面積極大，在各餐廳與別墅之間穿梭需騎乘單車或預約高爾夫球車接送。
熱門水上餐廳如 Tapasake 與 Botanica 的親水絕佳席位需提前預訂。

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: Victor，騎著單車穿梭在翠綠的棕櫚樹下，漫遊於 12 座純白沙灘間卻完全不需與他人掠過……Reethi Rah 所賦予的遼闊奢華感，與其他馬爾地夫度假村截然不同！

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: 這正是 Jean-Michel Gathy 的建築遠見。他將這座島嶼塑造為無限寬廣的熱帶天堂。這裡的 Grand Sunset Residence 曾接待過無數全球最顯赫的家族。

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: 還有在 Tapasake 水上餐廳邊欣賞絕美日落邊享用晚餐……火山石炙烤的和牛搭配冰鎮 Cristal 水晶香檳，簡直是人間仙境！

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: 一點也沒錯。記得提醒聽眾透過 Expedia 官方合作連結預訂，即可獲得豪華遊艇接送與 VIP 專屬 Spa 禮遇。

shorts.hook: 懸浮於海面上的和牛與壽司饗宴，伴隨絕美落日餘暉！
shorts.visual: 主廚在紫霞滿天的平靜海面上切分新鮮藍鰭鮪魚。
